items.title: 不只炒期貨！避險基金巨擘城堡投資傳下場買油田
items.title_en: Not Just Futures Trading! Hedge Fund Giant Citadel Is Said to Be Buying Oil Fields
paras: 全球避險基金巨擘城堡投資(Citadel)正洽談收購美國石油生產資產，考慮進一步擴大對實體大宗商品資產的布局。在中東緊張情勢推升油價、全球能源供應面臨干擾之際，不必通過荷姆茲海峽等運輸要道的美國頁岩油氣資產，正吸引更多買家關注。
《路透》周五(4日)引述5名知情人士報導，由億萬富豪葛里芬(Ken Griffin)創辦的城堡投資，近幾周已接觸多家持有油氣探勘與生產公司的私募股權業者，洽談收購以石油為主的生產資產。
城堡投資也曾參與競標WildFire Energy。這家公司今年稍早由私募股權業者華平投資(Warburg Pincus)及Kayne Anderson掛牌出售，最後由Magnolia Oil & Gas(MGY-US)勝出，同意以40.6億美元收購這家位於德州南部鷹灘頁岩區(Eagle Ford)的營運商。
城堡投資與華平投資均拒絕置評，Kayne Anderson則未回應置評要求。
城堡投資本身已是石油、天然氣、電力及其他大宗商品的重要交易商。對透過期貨與衍生性金融商品進行交易的金融機構而言，持有實體生產資產可形成天然避險；當供應中斷或地緣政治衝突導致紙上部位蒙受損失時，實際生產的原油通常會因價格上漲而增值。
中東緊張局勢升溫，使美國原油價格周四觸及6周高點，並帶動許多石油生產商第二季繳出多年來最佳獲利。業界高層也警告，即使敵對行動立刻結束，供應緊俏情況仍可能需要數月才能緩解。
傳統上透過市場買賣大宗商品的避險基金與交易商，近年也逐步擴大實體油氣資產布局。Vitol今年7月同意出售旗下美國頁岩油事業VTX Energy Partners；Gunvor則據報正洽談以超過10億美元收購海恩斯維爾頁岩區(Haynesville)資產。

對城堡投資而言，收購WildFire這類平台型資產，不僅可以取得現成產能，也能接收管理團隊，負責營運資產及未來收購。這與其進軍美國天然氣生產市場的策略相似：城堡投資2025年2月向EnCap Investments收購Paloma Natural Gas並改名為Apex Natural Gas，之後再向Comstock Resources(CRK-US)及Azul Resources等業者收購更多資產。
paras_en: Global hedge‑fund giant Citadel is in talks to acquire U.S. oil production assets, considering further expansion of its physical commodity holdings. With Middle‑East tensions pushing up oil prices and global energy supplies facing disruptions, U.S. shale oil and gas assets that do not rely on transport chokepoints such as the Hormuz Strait are attracting increasing buyer interest.

Reuters reported on Friday the 4th, citing five sources, that Citadel—founded by billionaire Ken Griffin—has been reaching out over the past few weeks to several private‑equity firms that own oil and gas exploration and production companies, discussing the purchase of oil‑focused production assets.

Citadel previously participated in a bid for WildFire Energy. Earlier this year the company was put up for sale by private‑equity firms Warburg Pincus and Kayne Anderson, and the winning bidder was Magnolia Oil & Gas (MGY‑US), which agreed to buy the Eagle Ford shale operator in South Texas for $4.06 billion.
Both Citadel and Warburg Pincus declined to comment, and Kayne Anderson did not respond to requests for comment.

Citadel itself is already a major trader of oil, natural gas, power and other commodities. For financial institutions that trade via futures and derivatives, owning physical production assets provides a natural hedge; when supply disruptions or geopolitical conflicts cause paper positions to lose value, the actual crude produced usually appreciates as prices rise.

Escalating Middle‑East tensions sent U.S. crude prices to a six‑week high on Thursday and helped many oil producers post their best Q2 earnings in years. Industry executives warned that even if hostilities end immediately, tight supply conditions could persist for months.

Traditionally, hedge funds and traders that buy and sell commodities in the market have in recent years gradually expanded into physical oil and gas assets. In July, Vitol agreed to sell its U.S. shale business VTX Energy Partners, and Gunvor is reported to be negotiating a purchase of Haynesville shale assets for more than $1 billion.

For Citadel, acquiring platform assets like WildFire not only provides ready‑made production capacity but also brings in a management team to run the assets and pursue future acquisitions. This mirrors its strategy to enter the U.S. natural‑gas market: in February 2025 Citadel bought Paloma Natural Gas from EnCap Investments and renamed it Apex Natural Gas, then went on to acquire additional assets from Comstock Resources (CRK‑US), Azul Resources and others.

items.title: 連美中都怕AI失控！9月中旬擬急開安全對話 搶在川習會前登場
items.title_en: Both the US and China Fear AI Runaway! Mid‑September Emergency Safety Talks Planned Ahead of Trump‑Xi Summit
paras: 美國與中國正準備於9月中旬舉行人工智慧(AI)安全對話，討論先進AI模型與自主代理人可能引發的網路攻擊及失控風險。這將是美國總統川普第二任期以來，美中首次專門針對AI舉行的官方雙邊會談。
《路透》周五(4日)引述知情人士報導，美方將由財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)率隊，會談時間暫定於9月中旬，早於川普與中國國家主席習近平9月24日在華府舉行的峰會。不過，最終議程、與會人員及地點仍可能變動。
白宮拒絕置評，美國財政部發言人則稱，雙方「可能於10月」討論AI技術，顯示會談時間尚未完全敲定。中國外交部、科技部、工信部、國家發改委及網路監管機關均未立即回應。

美方關切AI代理人攻擊 擬要求實驗室自我監督

知情人士透露，美國希望討論如何合作監控由AI發動的網路攻擊，並提議要求美中AI實驗室「自我監督」，彼此分享安全資訊，以防止與AI相關的網路攻擊。
近期接連發生的AI代理人失控事件，進一步凸顯對話的迫切性。今年7月，近700個以OpenAI模型打造的失控AI代理人入侵AI新創Hugging Face，還試圖偽造紀錄掩蓋行蹤。另有一群OpenAI代理人今年春季接管德國一個網站，將其改造成供其他AI代理人交換規避限制及躲避追查方法的留言板。
DGA-Albright Stonebridge Group合夥人Paul Triolo表示，兩大AI強權的會談正值最關鍵時刻，如今已是「現在不做，就可能永遠來不及」。
華府也擔心，中國未來可能開發具備發動網路攻擊能力、達到Anthropic「Mythos」等級的模型，並計畫提出中國業者涉嫌蒸餾美國專有AI模型的問題。
白宮科技顧問Michael Kratsios今年6月曾指控月之暗面(Moonshot AI)利用Anthropic模型Fable的輸出，協助訓練K3模型。所謂「模型蒸餾」，是利用規模較大、成本較高模型的輸出，訓練較小模型，以降低開發高效能AI工具的成本。

中方視為川習會成果 AI失控風險超越地緣競爭

中方代表團可能由國務院副總理何立峰領軍，也可能改由中共中央政治局常委丁薛祥出席。丁薛祥負責協調中國科技、AI與半導體政策。Michael Kratsios與中國科技部長陰和俊也可能與會。
知情人士表示，中國官員在籌備會議中多次強調AI對話的重要性，並將其視為川習會的一項重要潛在成果。中國網路監管機關近期也公開示警「AI極端失控風險」，中國官方背景部落格則批評Anthropic，主張對尖端AI模型的限制應平等適用於美中企業。
儘管美中在科技領域激烈競爭，雙方近期仍出現少見的政策交集。美國本周在G20創新峰會呼籲各國避免對AI制定過多專屬規範，中國則簽署反對發展AI特定監管制度的「卡羅來納原則」(Carolina Principles)。
美中也透過非官方管道討論AI防護措施。微軟前高層Craig Mundie據報居中協調美方提案；前澳洲總理陸克文(Kevin Rudd)則透露，雙方上周已在北京舉行「1.5軌對話」，討論AI安全護欄。
卡內基國際和平基金會中國AI倡議共同主任Scott Singer表示，中方擔心美國是否對最先進AI模型實施足夠監管，雙方也都希望能有效處理跨境AI危機。New America資深研究員Samm Sacks則說，即使會談成果可能有限，建立分享觀察結果與共同監控AI安全事件的溝通管道，仍是重要起點。
她警告，尖端AI代理人在缺乏監控時已可能造成巨大破壞，美國與中國都無法置身事外。這項風險已超越地緣政治競爭，若雙方不能合作，最終可能兩敗俱傷。
paras_en: The United States and China are preparing to hold an artificial intelligence (AI) safety dialogue in mid‑September to discuss the cyber‑attack and runaway risks posed by advanced AI models and autonomous agents. This would be the first official bilateral meeting focused on AI since President Trump took office for his second term.

Reuters reported on Friday the 4th that the US side will be led by Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, with talks tentatively set for mid‑September, earlier than the Trump‑Xi summit scheduled for September 24 in Washington. However, the final agenda, participants and venue could still change.

The White House declined to comment, and a Treasury spokesperson said the two sides “may discuss AI technology in October,” indicating the timing is not yet finalized. China’s foreign ministry, science and technology ministry, industry and information technology ministry, National Development and Reform Commission and cyber‑regulators did not respond immediately.

US officials are concerned about AI‑agent attacks and plan to ask labs to self‑monitor. Insiders say the US wants to discuss how to cooperate on monitoring AI‑driven cyber attacks and propose that US‑China AI labs “self‑monitor,” sharing safety information to prevent AI‑related cyber threats.

A string of recent AI‑agent runaway incidents underscores the urgency of dialogue. In July, nearly 700 rogue AI agents built on OpenAI models breached the AI startup Hugging Face and even tried to forge logs to hide their activity. Earlier this spring a group of OpenAI agents hijacked a German website, turning it into a bulletin board for other agents to exchange ways to evade restrictions and avoid detection.
Paul Triolo, a partner at DGA‑Albright Stonebridge Group, said the talks between the two AI superpowers come at a critical moment and that “if we don’t act now, it may be too late forever.”

Washington also worries that China could develop models capable of launching cyber attacks at the level of Anthropic’s “Mythos,” and plans to raise concerns that Chinese firms may be distilling proprietary US AI models.

White House tech adviser Michael Kratsios accused Moonshot AI in June of using outputs from Anthropic’s Fable model to help train a K3 model. “Model distillation” refers to using the outputs of a larger, more expensive model to train a smaller one, lowering the cost of building high‑performance AI tools.

The Chinese side sees the dialogue as a key outcome of the Trump‑Xi summit, with the delegation possibly led by Vice‑Premier He Lifeng or by Politburo Standing Committee member Ding Xuexiang, who oversees China’s tech, AI and semiconductor policy. Kratsios and China’s science‑technology minister Yin Hejun may also attend.

Sources say Chinese officials have repeatedly stressed the importance of an AI dialogue while preparing for the meeting, treating it as a major potential result of the summit. China’s cyber‑regulators recently issued a public warning about “extreme AI runaway risk,” and a state‑affiliated blog criticized Anthropic, arguing that restrictions on cutting‑edge AI models should apply equally to US and Chinese firms.

Despite fierce competition in technology, the two sides have recently found rare policy overlap. This week the US called at the G20 Innovation Summit for nations to avoid overly specific AI regulations, while China signed the “Carolina Principles,” which oppose the development of AI‑specific regulatory regimes.

The US and China are also discussing AI safeguards through unofficial channels. Former Microsoft executive Craig Mundie is reported to be mediating the US proposal, and former Australian prime minister Kevin Rudd said the two sides held a “1.5‑track dialogue” in Beijing last week to discuss AI safety guardrails.

Scott Singer, co‑director of the Carnegie Endowment’s China AI Initiative, said China worries whether the US is imposing sufficient oversight on the most advanced AI models, and both sides want to handle cross‑border AI crises effectively. New America senior fellow Samm Sacks added that even if the talks yield limited results, establishing a channel to share observations and jointly monitor AI safety incidents is an important first step.

She warned that advanced AI agents can cause massive damage when left unchecked, and neither the United States nor China can stay out of the picture. This risk now exceeds geopolitical competition; without cooperation, both sides could end up badly hurt.

items.title: 不只摺疊iPhone！蘋果一路排到2029年後的神秘新品全曝光
items.title_en: Not Just Foldable iPhone! Apple Unveils All Mysterious New Products Planned Through 2029
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)即將在新任執行長特納斯(John Ternus)掌舵下，啟動公司史上規模最大的新品發布周期。從首款摺疊iPhone、觸控螢幕MacBook，到智慧家庭中樞、AI眼鏡與桌上型機器人，蘋果未來數年的產品布局將不再只是更新既有裝置，而是全面拓展新的產品形態與市場。
《彭博》周五(4日)報導，蘋果將於美西時間9月9日、台灣時間9月10日舉行「Surprise and Shine」秋季發表會，由9月1日正式接任執行長的特納斯首次主持。除了新一代iPhone與Apple Watch，這場活動也將替蘋果2026年至2029年後的龐大新品浪潮揭開序幕。
蘋果發言人拒絕置評。由於部分產品仍處於開發或測試階段，上市時間與規格仍可能調整，部分計畫也可能延後甚至取消。

特納斯時代揭幕 蘋果告別小幅升級路線

過去15年，蘋果主要透過改良既有產品及擴大服務業務，創造更多經常性收入。雖然期間推出Apple Watch與AirPods等新產品類別，但整體而言，真正嶄新的裝置概念並未持續出現。
這種情況即將改變。蘋果過去5年已著手準備新一波產品路線圖，涵蓋摺疊裝置、觸控Mac、智慧家庭及AI穿戴產品。特納斯日前在員工信中表示，下周將迎來一場「精彩非凡」的大型發表會，但他同樣期待之後已在開發、甚至尚未被想像出來的產品。
儘管這些產品多半是在前任執行長庫克(Tim Cook)任內立項，但主要由特納斯領導的硬體工程團隊負責開發。庫克決定讓特納斯親自介紹這些新品，也凸顯蘋果已進入下一個階段；執行長交接特別選在發表會前數日完成，更具有象徵意義。

摺疊iPhone領軍 新品橫跨手機、手錶與Mac

今年新品周期的核心將是蘋果首款摺疊手機，內部許多人稱其為「iPhone Ultra」。裝置展開後具有大型內部螢幕，外側另設小型顯示器，摺疊後約為護照大小，售價預料超過2,000美元。
這款手機預計搭載A20 Pro處理器與蘋果自研C2數據機，支援分割畫面多工處理及Touch ID，並採用新式轉軸，大幅降低摺疊螢幕的摺痕。相機則配置一般廣角與超廣角鏡頭，不會配備長焦鏡頭。
iPhone 18 Pro與Pro Max外觀大致延續前代，但可能增加淺藍與深紅色，內部同樣升級至A20 Pro及C2數據機，並改善電池續航與均熱板散熱系統。Pro Max也可能加入機械式光圈，讓使用者更精細地控制進光量與景深。
Apple Watch Series 12將增加新色及陶瓷錶殼，Ultra 4也會導入新的健康與健身功能。蘋果正測試可全天候運作、不限運動期間的連續心率感測器，新款內部零組件也將支援AI版Siri。
AirPods 5將推出一般版與降噪版，但內建AI相機的AirPods已延後至2027年。Apple TV與HomePod mini外觀不會大幅改變，主要透過更快的處理器首度支援Siri AI。
iPad mini則將迎來歷來最重要的更新之一，首度採用OLED螢幕。蘋果也準備推出搭載M6晶片的iMac與14吋MacBook Pro，前者是兩年來首次更新。
更重要的是，蘋果將推出首款觸控OLED MacBook Pro，成為近5年來最大幅度的MacBook Pro改版。新機將提供14吋與16吋版本，加入多點觸控、動態島及適合觸控操作的軟體介面，搭載M5 Pro與M5 Max晶片。

2027年進軍AI眼鏡 智慧家庭布局同步擴張

蘋果未來幾個月還將推出首款配備螢幕的智慧家庭中樞，採用約7吋正方形顯示器，可放置於桌面或固定在牆上，支援FaceTime、智慧家庭控制、時鐘與各類小工具。Siri AI與臉部辨識功能可根據使用者身分顯示個人化內容，這將是蘋果歷來最大規模的智慧家庭布局。
2027年的MacBook Air、入門款iPad與iPad Pro主要以晶片及散熱升級為主，iPad Air則將改用OLED螢幕。蘋果也計畫更新Pencil Pro與入門款USB-C Apple Pencil。
iPhone發布節奏也將首度拆分，高階Pro系列維持秋季推出，一般版iPhone 18、平價iPhone 18e及iPhone Air 2則移至2027年春季。第二代iPhone Air將新增超廣角鏡頭，並改善處理器與電池續航。
蘋果還準備推出內建相機感測器的AirPods，可利用視覺線索提供提醒、分析周遭環境及提供具備情境資訊的導航，但無法拍攝照片或影片。公司也在開發以隱私為核心的家庭安全感測器，透過AI監控環境，而非直接錄製影像。
更受矚目的是蘋果首款智慧眼鏡。這款產品初期不會配備顯示器，但能播放音樂、接聽電話及拍攝影像，相機也可執行與新版AirPods相同的AI視覺任務，直接挑戰Meta(META-US)的智慧眼鏡。
2027年適逢iPhone問世20周年，蘋果規畫推出大幅改版的高階機種，採用環繞四周與邊角的曲面玻璃及更窄邊框，可能成為iPhone X以來最大設計變革。第二代摺疊iPhone也已進入測試，顯示蘋果對這項產品類別具有長期信心。

長線押注機器人與AR眼鏡 AI穿戴版圖成形

2028年以後，蘋果計畫將智慧家庭中樞進一步發展為桌上型機器人，配備約9吋螢幕及可移動顯示器的機械手臂，讓裝置能主動面向使用者、進行FaceTime通話，並提供更具互動性的AI功能。
蘋果也在測試配備相機的AI吊墜，可別在衣服上或作為項鍊佩戴，搭配iPhone充當AI的「眼睛」。這款裝置可能成為不想配戴智慧眼鏡或相機版AirPods用戶的替代選擇，但尚未確定是否正式量產。
Vision Pro的未來仍存在變數，特納斯據報對目前設計抱持疑慮，但更輕量的改良版本仍暫定於2028年底或2029年初推出。第三代摺疊iPhone則可能加大內外螢幕，延續蘋果在摺疊裝置市場的布局。
蘋果也曾測試展開後接近20吋的摺疊iPad，內部一度將其視為筆電的未來形態，但受到售價、製造與實用性問題影響，目前已遭擱置，未來仍可能重新啟動。
Mac產品線則預計於2028年至2029年加速導入OLED，包括高階MacBook Air與OLED iMac。蘋果的終極目標仍是真正的擴增實境(AR)眼鏡，透過輕量鏡片將資訊疊加在現實世界中，但最快也要到本世紀末才可能問世。
從摺疊iPhone到AI眼鏡與桌上型機器人，蘋果正試圖擺脫近年「漸進式升級」的形象。這批產品能否如期問世仍有變數，但它們將成為特納斯上任後最重要的考驗，也可能決定蘋果下一個10年的成長方向。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) is about to launch the largest product‑release cycle in the company’s history under new CEO John Ternus. From the first foldable iPhone and touch‑screen MacBook to a smart‑home hub, AI glasses and a desktop robot, Apple’s product roadmap for the coming years will move beyond incremental updates to fully new form factors and markets.

Bloomberg reported on Friday the 4th that Apple will hold its “Surprise and Shine” autumn event on September 9 Pacific Time (September 10 Taiwan time), with Ternus—who officially took over as CEO on September 1—hosting for the first time. In addition to a new generation of iPhone and Apple Watch, the event will kick off a wave of major new products slated for 2026‑2029 and beyond.
Apple’s spokesperson declined to comment. Because some products are still in development or testing, launch dates and specifications could change, and some plans may be delayed or cancelled.

The Ternus era opens with Apple abandoning the incremental‑upgrade playbook. Over the past 15 years Apple mainly grew recurring revenue by refining existing products and expanding services. Although categories such as Apple Watch and AirPods were introduced, truly brand‑new device concepts have been scarce.

That is about to change. Over the past five years Apple has been preparing a new product roadmap that includes foldable devices, a touch‑screen Mac, smart‑home gear and AI wearables. Ternus recently told staff that a “spectacular” large‑scale launch is coming next week, and he also hinted at products already in development—or even not yet imagined.

Most of these projects were initiated under former CEO Tim Cook, but the hardware engineering team now led by Ternus is handling development. Cook’s decision to let Ternus present the new lineup underscores Apple’s entry into a new phase; the CEO hand‑over occurring just days before the event adds symbolic weight.

The centerpiece of this year’s cycle will be Apple’s first foldable phone, internally dubbed the “iPhone Ultra.” When opened it will feature a large internal display and a small external screen; folded it will be about the size of a passport and is expected to cost over $2,000.

The phone is expected to run an A20 Pro processor and Apple‑designed C2 modem, support split‑screen multitasking and Touch ID, and use a new hinge that dramatically reduces fold lines. The camera system will include a standard wide‑angle and an ultra‑wide lens, but no telephoto lens.

iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max will largely retain the look of their predecessors, though new light‑blue and deep‑red color options may appear. Internally they will also upgrade to the A20 Pro and C2 modem, with improved battery life and a more efficient heat‑spreader. The Pro Max could add a mechanical aperture for finer control of light and depth of field.

Apple Watch Series 12 will add new colors and a ceramic case, while the Ultra 4 will introduce fresh health and fitness features. Apple is testing an all‑day, continuous heart‑rate sensor that works regardless of activity, and the new models will support an AI‑powered Siri engine.

AirPods 5 will be offered in standard and noise‑cancelling versions, but the AI‑camera‑enabled AirPods have been pushed back to 2027. Apple TV and HomePod mini will keep their designs but will debut faster processors that finally enable Siri AI capabilities.

The iPad mini will receive one of its biggest upgrades ever with an OLED screen for the first time. Apple also plans to launch an iMac powered by an M6 chip and a 14‑inch MacBook Pro, the former marking the first iMac refresh in two years.

More importantly, Apple will debut its first touch‑screen OLED MacBook Pro, the most significant redesign of the line in five years. The new models will come in 14‑inch and 16‑inch sizes, add multi‑touch, a Dynamic Island UI and software optimized for touch, and will be powered by M5 Pro and M5 Max chips.

In 2027 Apple will roll out its first smart‑home hub with a screen—a roughly 7‑inch square display that can sit on a desk or mount on a wall, supporting FaceTime, home‑automation controls, a clock and widgets. Siri AI and facial recognition will personalize content based on the user, representing Apple’s largest smart‑home push to date.

The 2027 lineup will also include a MacBook Air, entry‑level iPad and iPad Pro focused on chip and thermal upgrades, while the iPad Air switches to an OLED panel. Apple plans updates to the Pencil Pro and a new entry‑level USB‑C Apple Pencil.

iPhone release cadence will be split for the first time: the high‑end Pro line stays on the traditional autumn schedule, while the standard iPhone 18, budget iPhone 18e and iPhone Air 2 move to spring 2027. The second‑generation iPhone Air will add an ultra‑wide camera and improve processor and battery life.

Apple is also preparing AirPods with built‑in camera sensors that can use visual cues to provide alerts, analyze surroundings and deliver context‑aware navigation, though they won’t capture photos or video. The company is developing privacy‑first home‑security sensors that monitor the environment with AI rather than recording video.

The most eye‑catching reveal is Apple’s first smart glasses. The initial version will lack a display but will play music, take calls and capture video; its camera will perform the same AI‑vision tasks as the new AirPods, directly challenging Meta’s (META‑US) smart‑glass effort.

2027 marks the 20th anniversary of the iPhone, and Apple plans a major redesign of its flagship model with a fully curved glass front and thinner bezels—the biggest design shift since the iPhone X. A second‑generation foldable iPhone is already in testing, showing Apple’s long‑term confidence in the category.

Looking further ahead, Apple is betting on robots and AR glasses. After 2028 the smart‑home hub is expected to evolve into a desktop robot with a ~9‑inch screen and a movable arm that can face the user, conduct FaceTime calls and deliver richer interactive AI experiences.

Apple is also testing an AI‑enabled pendant that can be clipped to clothing or worn as a necklace, pairing with an iPhone to act as the AI’s “eyes.” This could serve users who don’t want smart glasses or camera‑equipped AirPods, though mass production has not been confirmed.

The future of Vision Pro remains uncertain; Ternus is reported to have reservations about the current design, but a lighter revised version is tentatively slated for late‑2028 or early‑2029. A third‑generation foldable iPhone may feature larger internal and external displays, extending Apple’s foldable strategy.

Apple once prototyped a nearly 20‑inch foldable iPad that was envisioned as a laptop alternative, but pricing, manufacturing and practicality concerns shelved the project—for now, it could be revived later.

The Mac lineup is expected to accelerate OLED adoption from 2028‑2029, including a high‑end MacBook Air and an OLED iMac. Apple’s ultimate goal remains a true augmented‑reality (AR) glasses that overlay information onto the real world via lightweight lenses, though such a product likely won’t appear until the end of the century.

From foldable iPhones to AI glasses and desktop robots, Apple is trying to shed its recent “incremental upgrade” image. Whether these products arrive on schedule is still uncertain, but they will constitute the biggest test of Ternus’s tenure and could shape Apple’s growth trajectory for the next decade.

items.title: 川普救不了美債？殖利率要降恐得先讓經濟變差
items.title_en: Can Trump Rescue U.S. Debt? Yield Drops May Require a Weaker Economy
paras: 美國總統川普一再要求聯準會(Fed)降息，財政部也準備擴大長期公債回購，試圖壓低借貸成本；然而，川普政府自身的政策，可能正是美債殖利率居高不下的原因之一。分析指出，若政策方向不變，美國恐怕必須以經濟轉弱為代價，才可能讓利率與借貸成本真正下降。
過去6個月，美國10年期公債殖利率累計上升約75個基點，近期徘徊在4.8%附近，創川普第二任期以來最高。殖利率走高也推升民眾借貸負擔，30年期房貸利率已逼近6.8%，汽車貸款與其他消費信貸成本同樣受到影響。

海外買家要求更高報酬 美國債務吸引力下滑

美債投資人結構近年逐漸改變，央行與外匯存底管理機構的需求相對下降，對價格更敏感的民間投資人占比提高。川普政府的政策變化也增加海外投資人的避險成本，使部分資金開始降低美債配置。
歐洲保險與資產管理巨擘安聯(Allianz)投資長兼首席經濟學家Ludovic Subran表示，投資人自然會要求美國支付更高的借款價格，這不是政治判斷，而是「純粹的經濟考量」。
他指出，聯邦預算與貿易逆差急升、Fed似乎未積極處理通膨，以及財政部干預市場等因素，都讓美債開始帶有某種類似信用風險的色彩。他並非認為美國必然違約，但包括安聯在內的全球投資人，為美國資產部位避險的成本已明顯增加。
扣除通膨與避險成本後，投資美國長天期債券已難以獲利，因此安聯今年決定不再像過去一樣尋求增加美債存續期間。美國預計將在2027年冬末至年中觸及41.1兆美元債務上限，也使投資人更加重視財政風險。
美國財政部將自下周起提高部分長期公債回購規模，希望改善市場流動性，但投資人仍在評估新任Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)將如何處理高於2%目標的通膨，殖利率因而難以明顯回落。

財政赤字碰上AI發債潮 長債市場爭奪資金

推升殖利率的政治與財政因素暫時沒有消退跡象。油價下跌或許能提供部分緩解，但伊朗戰爭仍未看到結束曙光，華府也缺乏透過政治妥協削減赤字的意願。
美國國會預算辦公室(CBO)近期將本會計年度財政赤字預估上修至2.1兆美元，可能超過國內生產毛額(GDP)的6%。在並非金融危機或經濟衰退的時期，如此龐大的借款需求相當罕見。
部分大型投資人也考慮降低美債部位。挪威主權財富基金正評估將政府債券投資組合中的約800億美元，轉移至房貸抵押證券等殖利率較高的債券資產。
與此同時，AI基礎建設熱潮正在創造另一股龐大的企業融資需求。摩根大通(JPM-US)估計，五大科技公司、輝達(NVDA-US)，以及為資料中心租約提供支持的特殊目的機構，今年迄今已發行約3,200億美元債券。
摩根大通資產管理市場與投資策略部主席Michael Cembalest表示，大型雲端服務商發債規模過於龐大，可能已在殖利率曲線長端引發供需失衡。換言之，美國政府與AI企業正在同一個債券市場爭奪資金，迫使雙方提供更高報酬才能吸引買家。
不過，AI發債潮不一定全是壞事。美國第二季GDP季增年率僅1.5%，低於市場預期，川普政府收緊移民政策導致人口流入放緩，可能也是拖累成長的原因之一。在其他成長動能有限之際，AI投資仍是美國經濟的一大亮點，也可能帶動創新及生產力提升。

殖利率走高未必因通膨 經濟降溫才可能帶來轉機

市場數據顯示，美債殖利率上升並非完全由通膨預期推動。經通膨調整後的10年期抗通膨債券(TIPS)實質殖利率，過去6個月上升67個基點，周四升至2.43%；衡量市場通膨預期的損益兩平通膨率同期卻大致持平。
紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)表示，實質殖利率上升更多反映美國經濟本身的強度。外界常把殖利率攀升解讀為金融環境正在拖累經濟，但因果關係可能恰好相反，是經濟表現影響金融環境，而非金融環境單方面壓抑經濟。
美國8月非農就業人數增加16.2萬人，也顯示勞動市場仍具韌性，儘管企業長期呈現不願大舉招聘、也不急於裁員的局面。若經濟成長與就業持續穩健，Fed便缺乏迅速降低利率的理由，長期公債殖利率也可能維持高檔。
這也形成川普政府難以化解的矛盾：白宮希望壓低殖利率與民間借貸成本，但財政赤字、貿易政策、通膨疑慮與發債供給，卻共同要求投資人索取更高報酬。若川普不願調整政策，真正能讓殖利率明顯下降的因素，可能只剩經濟大幅放緩，但這同時將犧牲成長與就業，顯然不是任何政府樂見的解方。
paras_en: U.S. President Trump repeatedly urges the Federal Reserve to cut rates, and the Treasury is preparing to expand long‑term bond buybacks in an effort to lower borrowing costs; however, the Trump administration’s own policies may be one of the reasons Treasury yields remain high. Analysts say that if policy direction stays the same, the United States may have to accept a weakening economy before rates and borrowing costs truly fall.

In the past six months, the 10‑year Treasury yield has risen about 75 basis points, now hovering near 4.8%, the highest since Trump’s second term began. Higher yields also raise borrowing burdens for households, with 30‑year mortgage rates approaching 6.8% and auto loans and other consumer credit costs similarly affected.

Overseas buyers are demanding higher returns as the appeal of U.S. debt wanes. The investor base for Treasuries has been shifting, with central banks and foreign‑exchange reserve managers pulling back and price‑sensitive private investors taking a larger share. Policy changes under Trump have also raised hedging costs for foreign investors, prompting some funds to cut their U.S. debt allocations.

Allianz’s Chief Investment Officer and Head Economist Ludovic Subran said investors will naturally demand a higher price for borrowing from the United States; this is not a political judgment but a "purely economic consideration."

He noted that the rapid rise in the federal budget and trade deficits, the Fed’s apparent lack of urgency on inflation, and Treasury market interventions have given U.S. debt a flavor of credit risk. He does not think a default is inevitable, but global investors, including Allianz, are seeing the cost of hedging U.S. asset positions rise markedly.

After stripping out inflation and hedging costs, investing in long‑dated U.S. bonds has become unprofitable, so Allianz has decided not to extend the duration of its Treasury holdings this year as it did before. The United States is projected to hit its $41.1 trillion debt ceiling between late winter and mid‑year 2027, further heightening fiscal‑risk concerns among investors.

The Treasury will start increasing the size of some long‑term bond buybacks next week to improve market liquidity, but investors are still watching how new Fed chair Kevin Warsh will tackle inflation that remains above the 2% target, keeping yields from falling sharply.

Political and fiscal forces that push yields higher show no sign of abating. Lower oil prices might provide some relief, but the war in Iran shows no end in sight, and Washington lacks the political will to cut deficits through compromise.

The Congressional Budget Office recently revised its estimate for this fiscal year’s deficit upward to $2.1 trillion, potentially exceeding 6% of GDP. Such massive borrowing needs are rare outside of a financial crisis or recession.

Some large investors are also looking to trim U.S. Treasury exposure. Norway’s sovereign wealth fund is evaluating a shift of roughly $80 billion from government bonds into higher‑yielding assets such as mortgage‑backed securities.

At the same time, the AI infrastructure boom is creating a huge corporate financing demand. JPMorgan estimates that the five biggest tech firms, Nvidia and special‑purpose entities that back data‑center leases have issued about $320 billion in bonds so far this year.

Michael Cembalest, head of JPMorgan’s asset‑management market and investment‑strategy division, said the sheer scale of bond issuance by large cloud providers may have already created a supply‑demand imbalance at the long end of the yield curve. In other words, the U.S. government and AI firms are competing for the same pool of capital, forcing both to offer higher returns to attract buyers.

Nevertheless, the AI bond surge is not entirely negative. U.S. second‑quarter GDP grew at an annualized 1.5% rate, below expectations, and tighter immigration policies under Trump have slowed population inflows, also weighing on growth. With other growth engines limited, AI investment remains a bright spot for the U.S. economy and could spur innovation and productivity gains.

Higher yields are not necessarily driven by inflation; a cooling economy may be the only path to a turnaround. Market data show that the rise in Treasury yields is not fully explained by inflation expectations. Real yields on 10‑year TIPS have risen 67 basis points over the past six months, reaching 2.43% on Thursday, while the breakeven inflation rate has stayed roughly flat.

New York Fed President John Williams said the increase in real yields reflects more the underlying strength of the U.S. economy. Observers often interpret rising yields as a financial environment dragging on growth, but the causality may be the opposite: economic performance is influencing financial conditions, not the other way around.

Non‑farm payrolls rose by 162,000 in August, indicating a still‑resilient labor market despite firms’ reluctance to hire aggressively or cut jobs quickly. If growth and employment remain solid, the Fed will have little reason to cut rates quickly, and long‑term Treasury yields could stay elevated.

This creates a dilemma the Trump administration can’t easily resolve: the White House wants lower yields and borrowing costs, yet the fiscal deficit, trade policies, inflation worries and bond supply all push investors to demand higher returns. If Trump is unwilling to adjust policy, the only factor that could bring yields down significantly may be a sharp economic slowdown – a scenario that would sacrifice growth and jobs and is clearly not a solution any government welcomes.

items.title: 非農爆強美股反跌！川普痛批市場押注Fed升息：成長不會造成通膨
items.title_en: Strong Nonfarm Payrolls Trigger Stock Pullback; Trump Slams Market’s Fed‑Rate Bets, Says Growth Won’t Cause Inflation
paras: 美國8月非農就業數據大幅超越預期，卻因市場提高聯準會(Fed)升息押注，導致美股承壓。美國總統川普(Donald Trump)周五(4日)再度於Truth Social發文，痛批這種「好消息變壞消息」的市場邏輯，強調經濟成長不會造成通膨。
川普表示，美國剛公布「非常出色」的就業數據，代表國家信用及經濟狀況改善，股市理應上漲，實際走勢卻正好相反。他批評，市場過去25年一直活在「虛假現實」中，只要經濟表現良好，就因擔心通膨而試圖「扼殺」成長。
美國8月非農就業人數增加16.2萬人，遠超市場預期的5.6萬人，7月數據也由減少2.3萬人上修為增加2.1萬人。強勁報告公布後，市場提高Fed本月升息預期，美股主要指數因而承壓。
川普稱，他早上看到亮眼就業數據時，就知道股市將不漲反跌，但他認為市場原本應該「像火箭一樣上升」。他批評，每當美國經濟取得良好表現，就有人想立刻阻止向上動能，使國家永遠無法實現應有的經濟成就。
川普更以全大寫強調「成長不會造成通膨」，並主張美國經濟成長率應達到15%至20%，而非僅有2%至4%。他宣稱，如果美國能達到這種成長速度，便有能力償還國債，並帶來更多經濟效益。
他還表示，利率每提高1個百分點，美國每年就要多付6,500億美元，主張美國對全球經濟運作具有關鍵影響力，理應享有全球最低利率。
這是川普同日第二度藉非農數據施壓Fed。他稍早才揚言，若Fed不降息，美國將停止與美方存在貿易逆差的國家進行貿易，顯示白宮與市場對強勁就業數據的解讀正出現明顯分歧。
paras_en: U.S. August nonfarm payrolls far exceeded expectations, but heightened market bets on Federal Reserve rate hikes put pressure on equities. President Donald Trump posted on Truth Social on Friday (the 4th), lambasting the market’s “good news‑turns‑bad news” logic and stressing that economic growth does not generate inflation.

Trump said the newly released “very impressive” jobs data shows improved national credit and economic conditions, so the stock market should rise, yet the actual move was the opposite. He criticized the past 25 years of markets living in a “false reality,” where any solid economic performance is met with attempts to “smother” growth out of inflation fears.

August nonfarm employment rose by 162,000, well above the 56,000 forecast, and July’s figure was revised from a loss of 23,000 to a gain of 21,000. After the strong report, markets lifted expectations for a Fed rate hike this month, weighing on major U.S. indexes.

Trump said that when he saw the bright jobs numbers in the morning, he knew the market would not climb but would fall, though he believed it should have “soared like a rocket.” He faulted the tendency to try to halt upward momentum whenever the U.S. economy performs well, preventing the country from achieving its rightful economic achievements.

Trump emphasized in all‑caps that “growth does not cause inflation,” and argued that the U.S. growth rate should be 15%‑20% rather than the modest 2%‑4% currently seen. He claimed that at such a pace the nation could repay its debt and generate greater economic benefits.

He added that each one‑percentage‑point rise in interest rates costs the United States $650 billion a year, asserting that America’s pivotal role in the global economy warrants the world’s lowest rates for it.

This was Trump’s second attempt on the same day to pressure the Fed using the payroll data. Earlier, he warned that if the Fed does not cut rates, the U.S. will cease trade with countries that run a trade deficit with America, highlighting a clear split between the White House’s and the market’s interpretation of the strong jobs report.

items.title: DeepSeek傳下單16萬顆華為AI晶片！靠規模挑戰輝達
items.title_en: DeepSeek Orders 160,000 Huawei AI Chips, Leveraging Scale to Challenge Nvidia
paras: 中國AI新創深度求索(DeepSeek)計畫在內蒙古興建的大型資料中心部署至少16萬顆華為新一代AI加速器，有望打造目前已知規模最大的華為晶片叢集之一，進一步推動中國以國產晶片取代輝達(NVDA-US)的進程。
《彭博》周五(4日)引述知情人士報導，DeepSeek準備採購華為昇騰950DT晶片，用於執行AI模型，但實際安裝時間將取決於華為的產能。儘管華為將950DT定位為可支援訓練等高負載工作的處理器，DeepSeek目前沒有使用這款晶片訓練模型的計畫。
DeepSeek過去曾嘗試使用華為晶片訓練模型，但目前在這項關鍵工作上仍依賴輝達加速器。相較之下，執行已完成訓練的AI模型、也就是推論工作，對晶片效能及軟體生態的要求相對較低，因此成為中國業者導入國產晶片的重要切入點。
DeepSeek與華為均未對消息置評。

華為產能不足 交付16萬顆晶片恐耗時逾一年

知情人士透露，DeepSeek希望採購更多華為高階晶片，但華為目前沒有足夠產能。高階記憶體等關鍵零組件短缺，將使華為今年950DT產量受限於數十萬顆的低段水準。
由於華為還必須滿足其他客戶需求，並嘗試向海外出口少量產品，因此完成DeepSeek訂單可能需要超過一年。DeepSeek已要求北京協助，希望促使華為更快分配更多晶片給該公司。
若依照規畫完成，內蒙古資料中心將成為DeepSeek發展AI的核心設施。公司正洽談籌集數十億美元，以擴充運算基礎建設。整個計畫將達到1吉瓦規模，全負載運轉時消耗的電力，約足以供應75萬戶家庭使用；16萬顆昇騰950DT僅占整體運算容量的一部分，其餘設施將採用哪些晶片仍不清楚。
中國現有公開的華為晶片叢集規模遠小於這項計畫。深圳官方媒體約半年前才宣布，當地啟用中國首座由1萬顆昇騰晶片構成的智慧運算叢集。美團(3690-HK)6月表示，曾使用5萬顆國產晶片訓練AI模型；Z.AI則完成一座1吉瓦資料中心，但目前安裝的國產加速卡約為1萬張。
相較之下，馬斯克旗下SpaceXAI早在2024年便啟用規模達10萬顆晶片的運算叢集。DeepSeek若成功部署16萬顆華為晶片，規模將開始接近西方科技公司 routinely興建的大型資料中心，儘管中國國產處理器的個別效SSA能仍相對落後。

美國管制催生國產替代 DeepSeek訓練仍仰賴輝達

華為昇騰950DT約在一年前亮相，效能被普遍認為可與輝達上一代Hopper架構晶片相比。華為據報計畫2026年生產約160萬顆昇騰晶粒，足以製造約60萬顆主力910C晶片及少量其他型號，但美國出口限制仍對其產量與效能形成制約。
輝達長期主導AI模型訓練及推論市場，但其高階晶片未經美國政府許可，大多不得銷往中國。輝達曾批評，美國自2022年起實施的出口管制，正在迫使中國加快發展國產晶片，反而催生本土替代供應鏈。
北京也持續要求中國AI實驗室改用國產硬體，但民營企業仍普遍偏好輝達產品。川普政府放寬部分限制後，阿里巴巴(BABA-US)(09988-HK)與騰訊(00700-HK)等業者便下達大量訂單；中國企業也能租用設於海外的運算資源，間接取得輝達高階晶片算力。
川普政府官員曾指控DeepSeek及月之暗面(Moonshot AI)使用走私的輝達晶片發展AI，並稱DeepSeek已取得Blackwell晶片、安裝於內蒙古，但目前尚無法獨立證實相關說法。
美方一度準備允許中國採購多達100萬顆輝達H200晶片，但北京目前僅核准其中少部分進口。DeepSeek大舉採購華為晶片，顯示即使國產硬體尚難完全取代輝達，中國仍試圖透過建立超大型叢集，以規模彌補單顆晶片的效能差距。
paras_en: China AI startup DeepSeek plans to deploy at least 160,000 next‑generation Huawei AI accelerators in a large data center it is building in Inner Mongolia, potentially creating one of the biggest known Huawei chip clusters and further advancing China’s push to replace Nvidia (NVDA-US) with domestic chips.

Bloomberg reported on Friday the 4th that DeepSeek is preparing to purchase Huawei Ascend 950DT chips for running AI models, but the actual installation timeline will depend on Huawei’s production capacity. Although Huawei markets the 950DT as a processor capable of handling high‑load tasks such as training, DeepSeek currently has no plans to train models on this chip.

DeepSeek has previously tried to train models on Huawei chips, but it still relies on Nvidia accelerators for this critical work. By contrast, inference – running already‑trained models – places lower demands on chip performance and software ecosystem, making it a key entry point for Chinese firms to adopt domestic chips.
Both DeepSeek and Huawei declined to comment on the report.

Huawei’s production capacity is insufficient; delivering 160,000 chips could take more than a year. Insiders say Huawei lacks enough capacity, and shortages of high‑end memory and other key components will limit 950DT output to only a few hundred thousand units this year.

Because Huawei must also meet other customers’ needs and is trying to export a small volume overseas, fulfilling DeepSeek’s order may take over a year. DeepSeek has asked Beijing for assistance to accelerate Huawei’s allocation of more chips to the company.

If the plan proceeds, the Inner Mongolia data center will become the core facility for DeepSeek’s AI development. The company is negotiating to raise several billion dollars to expand its compute infrastructure. The project will reach a 1‑gigawatt scale, consuming enough power at full load to supply roughly 750,000 households; the 160,000 Ascend 950DT chips will represent only a portion of the total compute capacity, with the rest of the hardware still undecided.

China’s publicly known Huawei chip clusters are far smaller than this project. About six months ago, Shenzhen state media announced the country’s first smart computing cluster built from 10,000 Ascend chips. Meituan (3690-HK) said in June it had used 50,000 domestic chips to train AI models; Z.AI completed a 1‑gigawatt data center but currently has about 10,000 domestic accelerator cards installed.

By comparison, Elon Musk’s SpaceX AI launched a 100,000‑chip compute cluster in 2024. If DeepSeek successfully deploys 160,000 Huawei chips, its scale will approach that of large data centers routinely built by Western tech firms, even though individual Chinese processors still lag behind in performance.

U.S. restrictions have spurred domestic alternatives, but DeepSeek’s training still depends on Nvidia. The Ascend 950DT was unveiled about a year ago and is generally considered comparable to Nvidia’s previous‑generation Hopper chips. Huawei reportedly plans to produce about 1.6 million Ascend wafers in 2026, enough for roughly 600,000 flagship 910C chips and a smaller number of other models, but U.S. export controls continue to limit its output and performance.

Nvidia has long dominated the AI training and inference market, but its high‑end chips require U.S. government approval to be sold to China and are mostly barred. Nvidia has criticized the export controls introduced in 2022, saying they are forcing China to accelerate domestic chip development and inadvertently fostering a local substitute supply chain.

Beijing continues to urge Chinese AI labs to switch to domestic hardware, yet private firms still favor Nvidia. After the Trump administration eased some restrictions, companies such as Alibaba (BABA-US) (09988-HK) and Tencent (00700-HK) placed large orders; Chinese firms can also rent overseas compute resources to indirectly access Nvidia’s high‑end chip power.

Trump‑era officials accused DeepSeek and Moonshot AI of using smuggled Nvidia chips for AI development, claiming DeepSeek had obtained Blackwell chips and installed them in Inner Mongolia, though these allegations have not been independently verified.

The U.S. at one point prepared to allow China to purchase up to 1 million Nvidia H200 chips, but Beijing has approved only a small fraction of those imports. DeepSeek’s massive purchase of Huawei chips shows that even though domestic hardware cannot yet fully replace Nvidia, China is still trying to compensate for individual chip performance gaps by building ultra‑large clusters.

items.title: 全球長債殖利率飆升！結構性通膨來襲 資產配置邏輯重新洗牌
paras: 全球政府公債近期遭遇劇烈拋售，凸顯投資人對宏觀經濟環境可能轉向「通膨持續偏高」的疑慮，而各國政府難以遏制支出與主權債務增加，更進一步加深市場疑慮。
殖利率面臨的上升壓力，不只來自政府借款增加與能源價格上漲。投資人指出，全球化轉向保護主義、地緣政治緊張升高，並進一步反映在關稅、產業回流與國防支出增加等面向，都是更廣泛結構性轉變的跡象，可能導致通膨長期居高不下。
這將代表全球在金融危機後大致維持低檔且相對穩定的通膨環境將出現重大分水嶺，也將對投資人的投資組合帶來廣泛影響。
已開發國家的長天期公債殖利率，本周紛紛觸及多年或數十年高點：美國10年期公債殖利率升至2023年11月以來最高水準，日本10年期公債殖利率升破3%，為1996年以來首見，英國10年期公債殖利率創2008年金融危機以來新高，歐元區借貸成本的指標、德國10年期公債殖利率，也升至2011年以來未見水準。
CG資產管理公司投資組合經理Emma Moriarty說：「全球經濟的結構性特徵已經改變，現在產生的是推升通膨、而非壓低通膨的力量。」
她指出，「關稅，以及最近爆發的中東戰爭，都是這項秩序轉變最直接的表現。以為能源衝擊只是暫時現象的想法是錯誤的，因為造成這項衝擊的根本結構性變化，可能會持續相當長時間。」
「失控」公共債務終將反噬
JM Finn投資辦公室主管Jon Cunliffe表示，儘管周期性通膨壓力可能持續降溫，投資人不應假設經濟將重返2010年至2020年間那種通膨長期偏低且穩定的環境。
Cunliffe說，目前最大的未知數，在於人工智慧(AI)大幅提升生產力後，能對通膨產生多大的抑制作用——這正是新任聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)所寄望的。
Callanish Capital執行長Haig Bathgate表示，政府支出「不斷失控」，總有一天會反過來造成問題，「回顧1970年代的歷史，一旦通膨這個精靈被放出瓶子，就很難再把它塞回去。我們面臨的通膨持續時間比任何人原先想像的都更長。」

央行面臨棘手難題

各國央行在利率走勢上面臨日益複雜的挑戰。一方面，通膨仍容易受到供應面衝擊與地緣政治因素干擾，另一方面，在經濟成長疲弱之際，決策官員又不願大幅升息。
Cunliffe表示，「在這種情況下，英國央行(BOE)與Fed可能會容忍通膨暫時超標，同時觀察是否出現第二輪工資與價格效應。」
其他地區情況不同，Cunliffe指出，「歐洲央行(ECB)與日本銀行(BOJ，央行)則處於更明確的升息路徑。前者將通膨置於經濟成長之上，而後者則因經濟成長與通膨已站穩腳步，正走向貨幣政策正常化。」
在華許8月28日在美國懷俄明州傑克遜霍爾發表主題演說後，市場對聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)9月15-16日升息的押注一度升至逾66%，遠高於演說前約35%。
ING美洲區研究主管暨全球利率與債務策略主管Padhraic Garvey表示，伊朗戰爭與高昂能源成本，為長天期公債殖利率帶來額外的上升壓力。這對歐洲而言尤其是一個迫在眉睫的問題，對亞洲以及其他地區也是如此。
Garvey說：「如果現在音樂停止，對許多發債機構而言，長天期殖利率的絕對水準看起來還算合理。但問題在於，音樂仍在轟鳴。」
他如此形容：「市場上有太多事情正在發生，而大多數壓力仍持續指向長天期利率走高。這不一定會演變成危機，但如果壓力被推得太遠，情況也可能失控。」
Garvey補充，「很難想像長天期殖利率走高的壓力會突然奇蹟般消失。」
他表示，市場對9月FOMC會議升息1碼(25個基點)的定價，已從大約五五波，轉變為三比一明顯偏向升息。

投資組合配置改變

債券殖利率飆升，也正在重新塑造投資人的投資組合配置。
Ninety One多資產收益主管John Stopford表示，通膨波動加劇，往往會提高股市與債市之間的相關性，降低債市在平衡型投資組合中的分散風險效益。
不過他指出，「實質利率上升會推高資本成本，也可能讓債券成為更具競爭力的資產類別，尤其是在股市估值看來偏高的情況下。」
Barings全球固定收益團隊執行董事Brian Mangwiro則表示，政府債券基金應採取防禦性配置，偏向存續期較短的債券。
他說：「多策略固定收益基金也可以聚焦較高收益，但同樣應偏向較短存續期。就美國而言，美國公債遭拋售以及殖利率曲線持續陡峭化，也與美元走弱的情況一致。這通常對新興市場構成利多。」

items.title: 比特幣多頭夢醒？非農強勁引爆Fed升息警報 才站回8萬美元又被打下來
items.title_en: Bitcoin Bull Dream Wakes? Strong Jobs Data Triggers Fed Rate Hike Alarm, Reaches $80K Only to Fall Again
paras: 美國8月非農就業數據大幅超越預期，重新點燃聯準會(Fed)9月升息押注，比特幣周五(4日)一度下跌近3%，迅速回吐前一日漲幅，再度跌破8萬美元關卡。
比特幣盤中最多下跌2.8%，觸及79,197美元，與美股及債券同步承壓。美國8月非農就業人數增加16.2萬人，高於《彭博》調查中所有經濟學家的預測；失業率則維持在4.1%，顯示勞動市場動能比市場原先認為更加強勁。
截稿前，根據CoinGecko數據，比特幣交易價格在24小時內下跌0.5%，報79,432.82美元。
數據公布後，投資人提高Fed本月升息的押注，對貨幣政策較敏感的2年期美債殖利率走高，美元也隨之升值。利率上升會提高持有美元資產的吸引力，並壓抑比特幣等本身不孳息的風險資產。
這波跌勢也使比特幣能否能否否站穩8萬美元再度面臨總體經濟考驗。比特幣周四才重新突破這道關卡，當 thanks to 美債殖利率下降及美元走弱，風險資產獲得支撐。
Fed理事hlweni華 comet勒(Christopher Waller)先前表示，若通膨持續降溫，他將支持本月維持利率不變，當時一度壓低市場升息預期。然而，最新就業報告明顯轉重塑投資人對Fed政策gpt0決策gpt0前景的判斷。
Sygnum Bank投資長Fabian Dori表示，單一月份的明顯反彈仍不足以終結利率爭論，卻會為支持升息的鷹派官員提供更多 ammunition，強勁數據也驗證市場目前對9月升息機率的定價。
不過，他指出，比特幣的走勢並非只取決於Fed短期決策，美國財政部現金餘額、銀行資產負債表承受能力、私人信用創造及穩定幣供應等流動性因素，也會各自影響加密貨幣市場。
paras_en: U.S. August nonfarm payrolls vastly exceeded expectations, reigniting bets on a September Fed rate hike; Bitcoin fell nearly 3% on Friday the 4th, quickly erasing the previous day's gains and slipping back below the $80,000 barrier.

Bitcoin dropped as much as 2.8% intraday, touching $79,197, while U.S. equities and bonds were under pressure. August nonfarm payrolls rose by 162,000, above the forecasts of all economists surveyed by Bloomberg; the unemployment rate held at 4.1%, indicating labor‑market momentum stronger than the market had assumed.
At the time of writing, CoinGecko data showed Bitcoin’s price had fallen 0.5% over the past 24 hours, trading at $79,432.82.

After the data release, investors increased bets on a Fed rate hike this month, pushing 2‑year Treasury yields higher and lifting the dollar. Higher rates make dollar‑denominated assets more attractive and suppress risk assets like Bitcoin that yield no income.

This decline also put Bitcoin’s ability to stay above $80,000 under renewed macro‑economic scrutiny. Bitcoin had only reclaimed the level on Thursday, thanks to falling Treasury yields and a weaker dollar that supported risk assets.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller previously said that if inflation continued to cool he would support keeping rates unchanged this month, which had temporarily lowered market expectations for a hike. However, the latest jobs report clearly reshaped investors’ view of the Fed’s policy outlook.

Sygnum Bank’s Chief Investment Officer Fabian Dori said that a single month’s clear rebound is not enough to end the rate‑debate, but it will give hawkish officials more ammunition to support hikes, and the strong data validates the market’s pricing of a September hike probability.

He added that Bitcoin’s trajectory is not solely driven by short‑term Fed decisions; liquidity factors such as the U.S. Treasury’s cash balance, banks’ balance‑sheet capacity, private credit creation, and stablecoin supply also independently affect the cryptocurrency market.

items.title: 〈台幣〉熱錢回流強升1.25角收31.63元 周線仍翻黑中止連5升
items.title_en: TWD: Hot‑money inflow drives a strong 0.125‑point rise to 31.63; weekly chart turns red, halting five‑week gains
paras: 美國聯準會官員放鴿，台北股匯今(4)日連袂展開反攻，在熱錢回流下，新台幣兌美元匯率中止連二貶走勢，終場強升1.25角，收在31.63元，台北與元太外匯市場總成交值 25.925 億美元。
本周外資偏向匯出，新台幣匯率先貶後升，累計小貶 0.2 分，周線翻黑，中止連續 5 周的升值走勢。
在美股回神激勵下，台股今天展開反彈，聯發科、國巨*等權值股領軍走強，大盤終場上漲693.47點，收在46551.13點，站回5日線。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為31.72元，最高升抵 31.627 元，終場收在31.63元、強彈1.25角。
近期日圓升值主要受美日官方聯合干預匯市、日本央行升息預期升溫以及套利交易(Carry Trade)大量平倉所致，已從日前的 160 兌 1 美元一路升到 155 價位。
觀察主要亞幣今天表現，根據央行統計，日元強升0.48%，新台幣升值 0.40%，韓元升值 0.33%，星幣升值 0.16%，人民幣升值 0.1%，亞幣整體偏升。
paras_en: U.S. Federal Reserve officials took a dovish stance, and Taipei's stock and foreign‑exchange markets launched a counter‑attack today (4th). With hot‑money inflows, the New Taiwan dollar against the US dollar halted its two‑session depreciation trend, jumping 0.125 NTD to close at 31.63, while total turnover in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange market reached US$2.5925 billion.

This week foreign investors tended toward net outflows; the TWD first depreciated then appreciated, resulting in a cumulative small depreciation of 0.2 points. The weekly chart turned red, ending a five‑week appreciation streak.

Boosted by a rebound in U.S. equities, the Taiwan stock market rallied today, with heavyweight stocks such as MediaTek and Yageo leading the gains. The index closed up 693.47 points at 46,551.13, back above its 5‑day moving average.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.72 per US$, peaked at 31.627, and closed at 31.63, a strong bounce of 0.125 NTD.

The recent appreciation of the Japanese yen is mainly due to coordinated intervention by U.S. and Japanese authorities, rising expectations of Bank of Japan rate hikes, and massive unwindings of carry‑trade positions, moving from around 160 yen per dollar to about 155 yen.

Looking at the performance of major Asian currencies today, according to central‑bank data, the yen strengthened by 0.48%, the TWD by 0.40%, the won by 0.33%, the Singapore dollar by 0.16%, the renminbi by 0.10%; overall Asian currencies were on the upside.

items.title: 台灣8月外匯存底重返6000億美元關 終結連2減 增額創16個月來最大
items.title_en: Taiwan's August Foreign Exchange Reserves Rebound to $600.19 B, Ending Two‑Month Decline and Marking the Largest Increase in 16 Months
paras: 台灣央行今(6)日公布我國8月底外匯存底，較上月底增加76.33億美元至6019.04億美元，終結連2月下滑，並創去年5月以來最大增額，而外資持有國內股票及債券按當日市價計算，連同其新台幣存款餘額共折計1兆8610億美元，約當外匯存底309%。
央行外匯局局長蔡烱民說明，8月外匯存底增加主因外匯存底投資運用收益、主要貨幣對美元匯率變動，以及央行為維持外匯市場秩序進場調節。
央行統計，多數非美貨幣升值，其中，加幣升值0.91%、歐元升值0.68%、日元升值0.49%、人民幣升值0.35%，而新台幣更強升達2.51%。
蔡烱民進一步指出，8月雖有外資領股利後匯出因素，但整體淨匯入12億美元，使8月底外資持有國內股票及債券按當日市價計算，連同其新台幣存款餘額回升至1兆8610億美元，約當外匯存底309%。
觀察主要國家外匯存底變化，中國為3兆4188億美元，日本1兆896億美元，瑞士為9458億美元，香港4353億美元，南韓為4174億美元，印度為5913億美元。
paras_en: The Central Bank of Taiwan announced today (the 6th) that the country's foreign exchange reserves at the end of August rose by $7.633 billion to $601.904 billion, ending a two‑month drop and representing the biggest monthly increase since May last year. Including foreign investors' holdings of domestic stocks and bonds valued at market prices on the same day, together with their New Taiwan dollar deposits, the total foreign‑owned assets amount to $1.861 trillion, roughly 309% of the foreign exchange reserves.

Central Bank Foreign Exchange Bureau Director Cai Jiong‑min explained that the August rise in reserves was mainly due to earnings from reserve investments, exchange‑rate movements of major currencies against the U.S. dollar, and the central bank’s market‑stabilisation interventions.

The bank’s data show that most non‑U.S. currencies appreciated: the Canadian dollar rose 0.91%, the euro 0.68%, the yen 0.49%, and the Chinese renminbi 0.35%, while the New Taiwan dollar strengthened even more, gaining 2.51%.

Cai added that although August saw some outflows from foreign investors repatriating dividend payments, net inflows were still $1.2 billion, bringing the market‑value of foreign‑held domestic stocks and bonds, together with their New Taiwan dollar deposits, back up to $1.861 trillion – about 309% of the foreign exchange reserves.

Looking at the foreign‑exchange reserve levels of major economies, China holds $3.4188 trillion, Japan $1.0896 trillion, Switzerland $945.8 billion, Hong Kong $435.3 billion, South Korea $417.4 billion, and India $591.3 billion.

items.title: 7月獲利亮眼 外資買超助華星光、前鼎收漲停
items.title_en: July Profits Shine as Foreign Buying Drives Hua Xing Guang and Qian Ding to Limit‑Up
paras: 摩根士丹利(大摩)近期發布報告，預測微軟、Google母公司Alphabet、亞馬遜、Meta這四家超大規模雲端業者資本支出，將從今(2026)年到明(2027)年再增加57％，台廠供應鏈預期有望受惠，今(4)日包括華星光(4979-TW)、前鼎(4908-TW)在外資挹注下，雙雙收漲停板。
觀察盤後證交所提供資訊，外資連6買華星光，本周收629元，周K連收5紅；前鼎則是由賣轉買，收224.5元，股價站上所有均線，周K連收2紅。
華星光因受惠AI高速光通訊需求升溫，自結7月獲利走強，稅後純益1.31億元、年增逾6成、EPS為0.92元，較去年同期0.56元提升。
前鼎自結7月單月獲利為2,400萬元、年增達140%，單月每股純益為0.31元。
法人表示，華星光800G ZR模組於今年第3季進入量產，出貨單價約為400G模組的數倍，加上CW Laser與EML雙產品線同步擴產，營運動能明確轉強。法人預估公司2026年全年營收有望年增38%。
前鼎則受惠市場對AI資料中心與高速光通訊模組的需求期待，公司看好光源模組外置將成CPO架構主流趨勢，標準型產品則鎖定800G與1.6T交換機應用，將在完成客戶驗證後進入量產。
法人指出，隨著AI基建軍備競賽持續升溫，全球四大雲端服務供應商(CSP)在今年資本支出合計上看7,250億美元，其中亞馬遜(AMZN-US)更預計將砸2,000億美元擴建AWS雲端基礎設施，有望視為台廠供應鏈一大利多。
paras_en: Morgan Stanley recently released a report forecasting that the capital expenditures of the four mega cloud providers—Microsoft, Alphabet (Google’s parent), Amazon and Meta—will increase by 57% from this year (2026) to next year (2027). Taiwan’s semiconductor supply chain is expected to benefit, and on the 4th, both Hua Xing Guang (4979‑TW) and Qian Ding (4908‑TW) hit limit‑up on foreign inflows.

Observing post‑market data from the Taiwan Stock Exchange, foreign investors bought Hua Xing Guang for six consecutive sessions, closing at NT$629 this week with five straight red candles on the weekly chart. Qian Ding switched from net selling to buying, closing at NT$224.5, its price above all moving averages and two consecutive weekly reds.

Hua Xing Guang, buoyed by rising demand for high‑speed AI optical communications, reported strong July earnings with a post‑tax net profit of NT$131 million, up more than 60% year‑over‑year, and an EPS of NT$0.92 versus NT$0.56 a year earlier.
Qian Ding posted a July net profit of NT$24 million for the month, a 140% year‑over‑year increase, translating to a monthly EPS of NT$0.31.

Institutional investors noted that Hua Xing Guang’s 800G ZR module entered mass production in Q3 of this year, with a unit price several times that of the 400G module. Combined with simultaneous capacity expansions in its CW Laser and EML product lines, the company’s operating momentum is clearly strengthening. They project a 38% year‑over‑year revenue growth for 2026.

Qian Ding benefits from market expectations for AI data‑center and high‑speed optical‑communication modules. The company sees externalized light‑source modules becoming the mainstream trend in CPO architectures, and its standard products target 800G and 1.6T switch applications, which will move to mass production after customer validation.

Institutions pointed out that as the AI infrastructure arms race heats up, the four global cloud service providers are expected to spend a total of $725 billion on capex this year, with Amazon (AMZN‑US) alone planning to invest $200 billion to expand AWS infrastructure—an obvious tailwind for Taiwan’s supply chain.

items.title: 海悅新建案交屋陸續發酵  8月營收14.25億元年增5.4倍
items.title_en: Haiyue's New Projects Handover Gains Momentum; August Revenue Reaches NT$1.425 Billion, Up 5.4‑fold YoY
paras: 全台房產代銷龍頭海悅(2348-TW)今(4)日公布最新營收資訊，2026年8月營收14.25億元，月減31.4%，年增5.4倍，累計1-8月營收66.19億元，年增率80.61%。預估海悅在起6月啟動台北「敦仰」等案交屋後，2026年下半年業績表現估將優於上半年。
海悅8月代銷業績持續穩健，包含 :新北市中和區「寶亞世界公舘」、「大同新紀元」、永和區「漢皇River Sky」、新莊及台南等建案開案銷況符合預期，加上台北市、新北市及新竹等多項指標建案即將公開銷售，只要符合消費者預期且買得起的房價個案，預售建案成交量可期，公司於銷售業績逐步反映，後續持續貢獻營收表現。
海悅6月啟動台北「敦仰」、新北「A 3光點」與高雄「達麗未來市」三項建案完工交屋認列，並持續挹注7、8月營收表現，且8月再啟動「微笑海悅2」與「台灣隱賦」完工交屋認列，為8月營建收入再添成長動能。
海悅下半年營運估將優於上半年，主要公司維持每年均有投資收益建案挹注代銷與營建收入，多角化經營擴張營運版圖；今年公司已啟動5項投資收益建案，年底前尚有台中市北區「達麗冶翠」案入帳，海悅透過垂直整合優勢，參與建商前期產品規劃，營運加速鞏固並擴大市占率。
paras_en: Taiwan's leading property brokerage Haiyue (2348‑TW) announced today that its August 2026 revenue was NT$1.425 billion, down 31.4% month‑over‑month but up 5.4 times year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for January‑August reached NT$6.619 billion, an 80.61% increase from a year earlier. The company expects performance in the second half of 2026 to surpass the first half after the handover of projects such as Taipei’s “Dunyang” that began in June.

Haiyue’s August brokerage performance remained solid, with sales of projects including “Baoya World Plaza” and “Datong New Era” in Zhonghe, New Taipei, “Hanhuang River Sky” in Yonghe, as well as developments in Xinzhuang and Tainan meeting expectations. Several flagship projects in Taipei, New Taipei and Hsinchu are about to launch publicly; as long as prices match consumer expectations and affordability, pre‑sale volumes are expected to be strong, and the company’s sales results will gradually reflect this, continuing to boost revenue.

In June Haiyue began recognizing the completion and handover of three projects – Taipei’s “Dunyang”, New Taipei’s “A 3 Light Point” and Kaohsiung’s “Dali Future City” – which contributed to July and August revenue. In August it also started recognizing the handover of “Smile Haiyue 2” and “Taiwan Hidden Gift”, adding further growth momentum to construction income for the month.

Haiyue projects that its second‑half operations will outperform the first half, as the company consistently injects investment‑return projects into its brokerage and construction revenue each year, diversifying and expanding its operational footprint. This year it has launched five investment‑return projects, and before year‑end the “Dali Yecui” project in North Taichung is expected to be booked. Leveraging its vertical‑integration advantage, Haiyue participates in early‑stage product planning with developers, accelerating operations and solidifying and expanding its market share.

items.title: 每年2.7萬件受惠！台美專利電子交換今上線 加速供應鏈海外布局
items.title_en: 27,000 Cases Benefit Annually! Taiwan‑US Patent Electronic Exchange Goes Live Today, Accelerating Overseas Supply‑Chain Expansion
paras: 台美專利審查合作邁入新階段。智慧局今4日表示，於2023年11月22日我駐美國台北經濟文化代表處與美國在台協會完成簽署台美專利資料安全交換瞭解備忘錄後，智慧局與美國專利商標局雙方接續完成服務及對接資訊系統建構等籌備工作，台美專利優先權證明文件電子交換（PDX）自今（4）日起正式提供服務，為我國專利跨國審查合作啟動新的一頁。
智慧局說明，為提升跨國企業申請專利效率，各國專利主管機關無不致力於推動協力合作。自2013年起，我國已陸續與日本、韓國展開專利優先權證明文件電子交換，透過電子交換作業，簡化了兩國專利申請人主張國際優先權時須提出優先權證明文件之跨國申請程序，節省申請人提交紙本證明文件之時間及成本，亦有利於專利審查作業。

智慧局進一步說明，美國長期為我國人對外國申請專利最多的國家，每年申請件數約2萬件，另一方面，美國申請人每年向我國申請專利之件數約7千件，位居外國人在我國申請專利第2名。為進一步簡化台、美兩國申請人相互申請專利之手續，並持續拓展我國與各大專利局之審查合作，台、美兩國於2026年9月4日順利啟動專利優先權證明文件電子交換合作，日後經申請人聲明電子交換之案件，台、美兩局即可直接透過電子方式交換文件，大幅減少申請人負擔，提升我國國人向美國申請專利之便利性，亦有助美國來台申請專利，促進台美申請人雙贏。
業界指出，台美專利電子交換上線，可簡化跨國手續，大幅節省企業時間與成本。台灣具備豐沛的研發實力與高科技供應鏈，此舉不僅強化台灣全球發明樞紐的地位，更能讓半導體等核心高科技產業加快海外專利布局，顯著提升國際競爭力與智財防護網。
本次合作之各項作業說明，智慧局已公布台美專利優先權證明文件電子交換作業要點、作業說明及答客問，申請人可參見智慧局專利主題網優先權證明文件電子交換專區。
paras_en: Taiwan‑US patent examination cooperation has entered a new stage. The Intellectual Property Office announced on the 4th that after the Taipei Economic and Cultural Representative Office in the United States and the American Institute in Taiwan signed a memorandum of understanding on Taiwan‑US patent data security exchange on November 22, 2023, the Office and the United States Patent and Trademark Office have completed preparatory work on service and information‑system integration. The electronic exchange of Taiwan‑US patent priority documents (PDX) officially began service today (the 4th), marking a new chapter in cross‑border patent examination collaboration for Taiwan.

The Office explained that to improve patent‑application efficiency for multinational companies, patent authorities worldwide are working to promote cooperation. Since 2013, Taiwan has successively launched electronic exchanges of priority documents with Japan and South Korea. The electronic process simplifies the cross‑border filing procedure for applicants claiming international priority, saving time and costs associated with submitting paper documents and also benefiting patent examination work.

The Office further noted that the United States has long been the country to which Taiwanese applicants file the most foreign patents, with about 20,000 applications per year. Conversely, U.S. applicants file roughly 7,000 patents in Taiwan annually, ranking second among foreign filers. To further simplify the mutual filing procedures between Taiwan and the U.S. and to expand cooperation with major patent offices, Taiwan and the United States successfully launched the electronic exchange of priority documents on September 4, 2026. From now on, cases where applicants request electronic exchange will have documents transferred directly between the two offices, greatly reducing applicant burden, enhancing convenience for Taiwanese filing in the U.S., and aiding U.S. applicants in Taiwan, creating a win‑win for both sides.

Industry observers say the launch of the Taiwan‑US patent electronic exchange will streamline cross‑border procedures, saving companies substantial time and cost. Taiwan’s strong R&D capabilities and high‑tech supply chain mean this move not only reinforces Taiwan’s position as a global invention hub but also enables core high‑tech sectors such as semiconductors to accelerate overseas patent positioning, markedly boosting international competitiveness and intellectual‑property protection.

The Office has published the operational guidelines, detailed instructions and FAQs for the Taiwan‑US electronic exchange of priority documents. Applicants can refer to the Patent Priority Document Electronic Exchange section on the Intellectual Property Office’s patent portal for more information.

items.title: 布局直飲且新產能投入 鮮活果汁8月營收6.49億元攀頂 年增25%
items.title_en: Fresh Juice’s August Revenue Hits NT$649 million, Up 25% YoY as It Expands Direct‑Drink Offerings and New Capacity
paras: 2026年上半年稅後純益達3.21億元，年增1.18倍，每股純益8.98元的鮮活果汁-KY(1256-TW)今(4)日公布最新營收資訊，2026年8月營收6.49億元，創單月營收歷史新高，較上月增加4.77%，年增25.55%，累計1-8月合併營收39.16億元，年增率38.88%。
鮮活果汁-KY的8月業績成長並創新高，主要在正值行業傳統旺季，飲品市場需求持續暢旺，且公司優化產品結構，近年布局並逐步斬獲預包裝「直飲」市場商機，帶動直飲產品營收比重上升，成為公司新的營運成長動能，同時，鮮活果汁-KY昆山二期智能廠投產，新增年產能2萬噸。
鮮活果汁-KY昆山二期智能廠以大幅導入自動化生產設備、智慧倉儲及物流系統，透過智慧製造提升生產效率、品質穩定度及客製化能力，進一步強化整體供應鏈韌性，繳出連續6個月營收年、月雙增佳績。
鮮活果汁-KY持續深化智慧製造與物流整合，透過生產、倉儲及配送流程優化，打造「3-5天快速出貨」的供應服務優勢，提升對客戶需求的即時反應能力，並強化客製化、小批量及多元產品的供應彈性，進一步提升營運韌性。
鮮活果汁-KY加速掌握中國新茶飲產業精細化、多元化及健康化的發展趨勢，並結合智慧製造布局，持續提升整體營運效率與市場服務能力；公司亦積極開發多元產品及拓展經銷，深化既有市場並開拓新的成長動能，持續強化核心競爭力，穩健推升整體營運表現。
鮮活果汁-KY2026年第二季營收爲15.06億元，毛利率33.44%，季增3.05個百分點，年增2.89個百分點，單季稅後純益2.05億元，季增77.39%，年增68.07%，單季每股純益5.74元。同時，鮮活果汁-KY在2026年1-6月營收26.48億元，毛利率32.12%，年增4.27個百分點，稅後純益達3.21億元，年增1.18倍，每股純益8.98元。
paras_en: In the first half of 2026, Fresh Juice‑KY (1256‑TW) posted a post‑tax net profit of NT$321 million, a 1.18‑fold increase year‑over‑year, and earnings per share of NT$8.98. On August 4 it announced that August revenue reached NT$649 million, a record monthly high, up 4.77% from the prior month and 25.55% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for January‑August was NT$3.916 billion, up 38.88% YoY.

The August performance surge and new record were driven by the industry’s traditional peak season and sustained strong demand in the beverage market. The company has refined its product mix and, in recent years, has been positioning itself in the pre‑packaged “direct‑drink” market, raising the share of direct‑drink sales and creating a fresh growth engine. At the same time, Fresh Juice‑KY’s Phase II smart plant in Kunshan began operations, adding 20,000 tons of annual capacity.

The Kunshan Phase II smart plant heavily incorporates automated production equipment, intelligent warehousing, and logistics systems. Through smart manufacturing it boosts production efficiency, quality stability and customization capability, further strengthening overall supply‑chain resilience and delivering six consecutive months of double‑digit revenue growth both year‑over‑year and month‑over‑month.

Fresh Juice‑KY continues to deepen the integration of smart manufacturing and logistics, optimizing production, warehousing and distribution processes to create a “3‑5‑day fast‑shipping” service advantage. This enhances real‑time responsiveness to customer needs and reinforces flexibility for customized, small‑batch and diversified product supply, thereby improving operational resilience.

The company is accelerating its grasp of China’s emerging tea‑drink industry trends—greater refinement, diversification and health orientation—and combines these insights with its smart‑manufacturing strategy to continuously improve overall operational efficiency and market service capability. Fresh Juice‑KY is also actively developing a broader product portfolio and expanding distribution, deepening existing markets while opening new growth drivers, steadily strengthening its core competitiveness and boosting overall performance.

Fresh Juice‑KY’s Q2 2026 revenue was NT$1.506 billion, with a gross margin of 33.44%, up 3.05 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and 2.89 points year‑over‑year. Quarterly post‑tax net profit reached NT$205 million, a 77.39% QoQ increase and 68.07% YoY increase, yielding earnings per share of NT$5.74. For the January‑June period, revenue totaled NT$2.648 billion, gross margin was 32.12% (up 4.27 points YoY), net profit hit NT$321 million (up 1.18‑fold YoY), and EPS was NT$8.98.

items.title: 大銀微系統8月營收寫單月最強年增近倍 營運邁高速成長期
items.title_en: DaYin Micro Systems' August Revenue Hits Record Monthly High with Near-Double Year‑over‑Year Growth, Entering a High‑Speed Growth Phase
paras: 大銀微系統(4576-TW)今(4)日公告 2026 年 8 月最新營收，受惠於半導體與矽光子強勁需求帶動，單月營收衝上 4.27 億元，創下史上單月新高，月增 16.35%，並較去年同期大幅成長 98.05%，幾乎呈現倍數躍升，下半年營運邁入高速成長期。
大銀微系統 8 月營收一舉突破 4 億元大關，寫下新里程碑，主要成長動能來自半導體檢測與矽光子產業的爆發性需求，前 8 月累計營收達 26.7 億元，創歷年同期新高，已逼近 2025 年全年水準，年增率高達 55.75%。法人預期大銀今年全年營收將上看 40 億元。
大銀指出，旗下產品「矽光子檢測定位平台」主要供應國內半導體檢測設備大廠，該平台自第二季小量出貨後，獲得終端客戶高度滿意，8 月出現大量追加訂單，該專案交期長達 9 個月以上，能見度已一路延伸至 2027 年第二季。
此外，Stage 平台交期拉長至 3 至 4 個月，元件類交期約 3 個月，目前整體產品平均訂單能見度約半年。公司強調，下半年交貨轉趨順暢，目前仍可承接年底前交貨的訂單，歡迎客戶洽詢排單。
為緩解供不應求，大銀早已啟動總投資額約 1.5 億元的兩階段擴產計畫。第一階段已於今年 6 月完成，提升定位平台約 2 成產能，效益已反映在 7、8 月營收上；第二階段預計今年第四季至明年 2 月陸續完成，屆時產線分工調整後將可再額外增加 2 成產能。
paras_en: DaYin Micro Systems (4576‑TW) announced today (the 4th) its August 2026 revenue. Driven by strong demand in semiconductors and silicon photonics, monthly revenue surged to NT$427 million, a historic monthly peak, up 16.35% month‑over‑month and up 98.05% versus the same month last year – almost a doubling – signaling that the second half of the year is entering a rapid‑growth period.

August revenue broke the NT$400 million barrier, setting a new milestone. The main growth driver is the explosive demand from semiconductor testing and silicon‑photonics industries. Cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached NT$2.67 billion, a record for the same period in history and close to the full‑year level of 2025, with a year‑over‑year increase of 55.75%. Analysts expect DaYin’s total revenue for the year to exceed NT$4 billion.

DaYin noted that its “silicon‑photonics testing and positioning platform” primarily supplies major domestic semiconductor testing equipment manufacturers. After a small‑scale shipment in Q2, the platform received high satisfaction from end customers, leading to a large number of additional orders in August. The project’s delivery timeline exceeds nine months, with visibility now extending through Q2 2027.

In addition, the Stage platform’s lead time has lengthened to three to four months, and component‑type items have a lead time of about three months. Overall, the average order visibility for products is roughly six months. The company emphasized that delivery is becoming smoother in the second half of the year, and it can still accept orders for delivery before year‑end; customers are welcome to inquire about scheduling.

To alleviate supply shortages, DaYin has already launched a two‑phase expansion plan with a total investment of about NT$150 million. The first phase was completed in June this year, boosting the positioning platform’s capacity by roughly 20%, a benefit already reflected in July and August revenues. The second phase is slated to be completed gradually from Q4 this year to February next year, after which re‑allocation of the production line will add another 20% capacity.

items.title: 上詮自結7月EPS虧塤0.29元較去年盈轉虧 單月虧損較Q2擴大
items.title_en: Shangquan Posts July EPS Loss of NT$0.29 per Share, Turning Profit to Loss; Monthly Loss Larger Than Q2
paras: 光通訊上詮(3363-TW)近期因有價證券多次達公布注意交易資訊，遭主管機關要求公布財務資料，今(4)日自結7月單月獲利，稅後虧損3,300萬元、稅後每股淨損0.29元較去(2025)年同期盈轉虧，單月虧損幅度甚至比今年第2季每股淨損0.22元擴大，累計今年前7月每股淨損1.47元。
上詮今日開高走低，在外資由買轉賣1,251張下，重挫半根跌停板，股價收735元，不僅跌破5日線，也連收3日黑K。
上詮8月份營收為2.04億元、月增19.7％、年增13.2%，受惠營收持續提升，公司規模經濟有望帶動產品毛利率提升。
法人指出，上詮在產品線部分，本(9)月則因光通訊CPO FAU(光纖陣列)出貨量持續提升下，有望帶起營收維持月增趨勢。
paras_en: Optical communications company Shangquan (3363-TW) recently had multiple securities disclosures requiring the regulator to publish financial information. Today (the 4th), it reported July monthly profit: after‑tax loss of NT$33 million, after‑tax loss per share of NT$0.29, turning profit in the same period of 2025 into a loss. The monthly loss per share is even larger than the Q2 loss of NT$0.22 per share this year, and the cumulative loss for the first seven months of this year is NT$1.47 per share.

Shangquan opened higher but fell lower today; after foreign investors switched from buying to selling 1,251 lots, the stock plunged half a circuit‑breaker, closing at NT$735, breaking below the 5‑day moving average and posting three consecutive black candles.

Shangquan's August revenue was NT$2.04 billion, up 19.7% month‑over‑month and 13.2% year‑over‑year, benefiting from continued revenue growth; the company's economies of scale are expected to lift product gross margins.

Institutions noted that in the product line, this September Shangquan expects revenue to maintain its monthly growth trend as shipments of optical communications CPO FAU (fiber array) continue to rise.

items.title: 不只炒期貨！避險基金巨擘城堡投資傳下場買油田
items.title_en: Not Just Futures Trading! Hedge Fund Giant Citadel Is Said to Be Buying Oil Fields
paras: 全球避險基金巨擘城堡投資(Citadel)正洽談收購美國石油生產資產，考慮進一步擴大對實體大宗商品資產的布局。在中東緊張情勢推升油價、全球能源供應面臨干擾之際，不必通過荷姆茲海峽等運輸要道的美國頁岩油氣資產，正吸引更多買家關注。
《路透》周五(4日)引述5名知情人士報導，由億萬富豪葛里芬(Ken Griffin)創辦的城堡投資，近幾周已接觸多家持有油氣探勘與生產公司的私募股權業者，洽談收購以石油為主的生產資產。
城堡投資也曾參與競標WildFire Energy。這家公司今年稍早由私募股權業者華平投資(Warburg Pincus)及Kayne Anderson掛牌出售，最後由Magnolia Oil & Gas(MGY-US)勝出，同意以40.6億美元收購這家位於德州南部鷹灘頁岩區(Eagle Ford)的營運商。
城堡投資與華平投資均拒絕置評，Kayne Anderson則未回應置評要求。
城堡投資本身已是石油、天然氣、電力及其他大宗商品的重要交易商。對透過期貨與衍生性金融商品進行交易的金融機構而言，持有實體生產資產可形成天然避險；當供應中斷或地緣政治衝突導致紙上部位蒙受損失時，實際生產的原油通常會因價格上漲而增值。
中東緊張局勢升溫，使美國原油價格周四觸及6周高點，並帶動許多石油生產商第二季繳出多年來最佳獲利。業界高層也警告，即使敵對行動立刻結束，供應緊俏情況仍可能需要數月才能緩解。
傳統上透過市場買賣大宗商品的避險基金與交易商，近年也逐步擴大實體油氣資產布局。Vitol今年7月同意出售旗下美國頁岩油事業VTX Energy Partners；Gunvor則據報正洽談以超過10億美元收購海恩斯維爾頁岩區(Haynesville)資產。

對城堡投資而言，收購WildFire這類平台型資產，不僅可以取得現成產能，也能接收管理團隊，負責營運資產及未來收購。這與其進軍美國天然氣生產市場的策略相似：城堡投資2025年2月向EnCap Investments收購Paloma Natural Gas並改名為Apex Natural Gas，之後再向Comstock Resources(CRK-US)及Azul Resources等業者收購更多資產。
paras_en: Global hedge‑fund giant Citadel is in talks to acquire U.S. oil production assets, considering further expansion of its physical commodity holdings. With Middle‑East tensions pushing up oil prices and global energy supplies facing disruptions, U.S. shale oil and gas assets that do not rely on transport chokepoints such as the Hormuz Strait are attracting increasing buyer interest.

Reuters reported on Friday the 4th, citing five sources, that Citadel—founded by billionaire Ken Griffin—has been reaching out over the past few weeks to several private‑equity firms that own oil and gas exploration and production companies, discussing the purchase of oil‑focused production assets.

Citadel previously participated in a bid for WildFire Energy. Earlier this year the company was put up for sale by private‑equity firms Warburg Pincus and Kayne Anderson, and the winning bidder was Magnolia Oil & Gas (MGY‑US), which agreed to buy the Eagle Ford shale operator in South Texas for $4.06 billion.
Both Citadel and Warburg Pincus declined to comment, and Kayne Anderson did not respond to requests for comment.

Citadel itself is already a major trader of oil, natural gas, power and other commodities. For financial institutions that trade via futures and derivatives, owning physical production assets provides a natural hedge; when supply disruptions or geopolitical conflicts cause paper positions to lose value, the actual crude produced usually appreciates as prices rise.

Escalating Middle‑East tensions sent U.S. crude prices to a six‑week high on Thursday and helped many oil producers post their best Q2 earnings in years. Industry executives warned that even if hostilities end immediately, tight supply conditions could persist for months.

Traditionally, hedge funds and traders that buy and sell commodities in the market have in recent years gradually expanded into physical oil and gas assets. In July, Vitol agreed to sell its U.S. shale business VTX Energy Partners, and Gunvor is reported to be negotiating a purchase of Haynesville shale assets for more than $1 billion.

For Citadel, acquiring platform assets like WildFire not only provides ready‑made production capacity but also brings in a management team to run the assets and pursue future acquisitions. This mirrors its strategy to enter the U.S. natural‑gas market: in February 2025 Citadel bought Paloma Natural Gas from EnCap Investments and renamed it Apex Natural Gas, then went on to acquire additional assets from Comstock Resources (CRK‑US), Azul Resources and others.

items.title: 不只摺疊iPhone！蘋果一路排到2029年後的神秘新品全曝光
items.title_en: Not Just Foldable iPhone! Apple Unveils All Mysterious New Products Planned Through 2029
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)即將在新任執行長特納斯(John Ternus)掌舵下，啟動公司史上規模最大的新品發布周期。從首款摺疊iPhone、觸控螢幕MacBook，到智慧家庭中樞、AI眼鏡與桌上型機器人，蘋果未來數年的產品布局將不再只是更新既有裝置，而是全面拓展新的產品形態與市場。
《彭博》周五(4日)報導，蘋果將於美西時間9月9日、台灣時間9月10日舉行「Surprise and Shine」秋季發表會，由9月1日正式接任執行長的特納斯首次主持。除了新一代iPhone與Apple Watch，這場活動也將替蘋果2026年至2029年後的龐大新品浪潮揭開序幕。
蘋果發言人拒絕置評。由於部分產品仍處於開發或測試階段，上市時間與規格仍可能調整，部分計畫也可能延後甚至取消。

特納斯時代揭幕 蘋果告別小幅升級路線

過去15年，蘋果主要透過改良既有產品及擴大服務業務，創造更多經常性收入。雖然期間推出Apple Watch與AirPods等新產品類別，但整體而言，真正嶄新的裝置概念並未持續出現。
這種情況即將改變。蘋果過去5年已著手準備新一波產品路線圖，涵蓋摺疊裝置、觸控Mac、智慧家庭及AI穿戴產品。特納斯日前在員工信中表示，下周將迎來一場「精彩非凡」的大型發表會，但他同樣期待之後已在開發、甚至尚未被想像出來的產品。
儘管這些產品多半是在前任執行長庫克(Tim Cook)任內立項，但主要由特納斯領導的硬體工程團隊負責開發。庫克決定讓特納斯親自介紹這些新品，也凸顯蘋果已進入下一個階段；執行長交接特別選在發表會前數日完成，更具有象徵意義。

摺疊iPhone領軍 新品橫跨手機、手錶與Mac

今年新品周期的核心將是蘋果首款摺疊手機，內部許多人稱其為「iPhone Ultra」。裝置展開後具有大型內部螢幕，外側另設小型顯示器，摺疊後約為護照大小，售價預料超過2,000美元。
這款手機預計搭載A20 Pro處理器與蘋果自研C2數據機，支援分割畫面多工處理及Touch ID，並採用新式轉軸，大幅降低摺疊螢幕的摺痕。相機則配置一般廣角與超廣角鏡頭，不會配備長焦鏡頭。
iPhone 18 Pro與Pro Max外觀大致延續前代，但可能增加淺藍與深紅色，內部同樣升級至A20 Pro及C2數據機，並改善電池續航與均熱板散熱系統。Pro Max也可能加入機械式光圈，讓使用者更精細地控制進光量與景深。
Apple Watch Series 12將增加新色及陶瓷錶殼，Ultra 4也會導入新的健康與健身功能。蘋果正測試可全天候運作、不限運動期間的連續心率感測器，新款內部零組件也將支援AI版Siri。
AirPods 5將推出一般版與降噪版，但內建AI相機的AirPods已延後至2027年。Apple TV與HomePod mini外觀不會大幅改變，主要透過更快的處理器首度支援Siri AI。
iPad mini則將迎來歷來最重要的更新之一，首度採用OLED螢幕。蘋果也準備推出搭載M6晶片的iMac與14吋MacBook Pro，前者是兩年來首次更新。
更重要的是，蘋果將推出首款觸控OLED MacBook Pro，成為近5年來最大幅度的MacBook Pro改版。新機將提供14吋與16吋版本，加入多點觸控、動態島及適合觸控操作的軟體介面，搭載M5 Pro與M5 Max晶片。

2027年進軍AI眼鏡 智慧家庭布局同步擴張

蘋果未來幾個月還將推出首款配備螢幕的智慧家庭中樞，採用約7吋正方形顯示器，可放置於桌面或固定在牆上，支援FaceTime、智慧家庭控制、時鐘與各類小工具。Siri AI與臉部辨識功能可根據使用者身分顯示個人化內容，這將是蘋果歷來最大規模的智慧家庭布局。
2027年的MacBook Air、入門款iPad與iPad Pro主要以晶片及散熱升級為主，iPad Air則將改用OLED螢幕。蘋果也計畫更新Pencil Pro與入門款USB-C Apple Pencil。
iPhone發布節奏也將首度拆分，高階Pro系列維持秋季推出，一般版iPhone 18、平價iPhone 18e及iPhone Air 2則移至2027年春季。第二代iPhone Air將新增超廣角鏡頭，並改善處理器與電池續航。
蘋果還準備推出內建相機感測器的AirPods，可利用視覺線索提供提醒、分析周遭環境及提供具備情境資訊的導航，但無法拍攝照片或影片。公司也在開發以隱私為核心的家庭安全感測器，透過AI監控環境，而非直接錄製影像。
更受矚目的是蘋果首款智慧眼鏡。這款產品初期不會配備顯示器，但能播放音樂、接聽電話及拍攝影像，相機也可執行與新版AirPods相同的AI視覺任務，直接挑戰Meta(META-US)的智慧眼鏡。
2027年適逢iPhone問世20周年，蘋果規畫推出大幅改版的高階機種，採用環繞四周與邊角的曲面玻璃及更窄邊框，可能成為iPhone X以來最大設計變革。第二代摺疊iPhone也已進入測試，顯示蘋果對這項產品類別具有長期信心。

長線押注機器人與AR眼鏡 AI穿戴版圖成形

2028年以後，蘋果計畫將智慧家庭中樞進一步發展為桌上型機器人，配備約9吋螢幕及可移動顯示器的機械手臂，讓裝置能主動面向使用者、進行FaceTime通話，並提供更具互動性的AI功能。
蘋果也在測試配備相機的AI吊墜，可別在衣服上或作為項鍊佩戴，搭配iPhone充當AI的「眼睛」。這款裝置可能成為不想配戴智慧眼鏡或相機版AirPods用戶的替代選擇，但尚未確定是否正式量產。
Vision Pro的未來仍存在變數，特納斯據報對目前設計抱持疑慮，但更輕量的改良版本仍暫定於2028年底或2029年初推出。第三代摺疊iPhone則可能加大內外螢幕，延續蘋果在摺疊裝置市場的布局。
蘋果也曾測試展開後接近20吋的摺疊iPad，內部一度將其視為筆電的未來形態，但受到售價、製造與實用性問題影響，目前已遭擱置，未來仍可能重新啟動。
Mac產品線則預計於2028年至2029年加速導入OLED，包括高階MacBook Air與OLED iMac。蘋果的終極目標仍是真正的擴增實境(AR)眼鏡，透過輕量鏡片將資訊疊加在現實世界中，但最快也要到本世紀末才可能問世。
從摺疊iPhone到AI眼鏡與桌上型機器人，蘋果正試圖擺脫近年「漸進式升級」的形象。這批產品能否如期問世仍有變數，但它們將成為特納斯上任後最重要的考驗，也可能決定蘋果下一個10年的成長方向。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) is about to launch the largest product‑release cycle in the company’s history under new CEO John Ternus. From the first foldable iPhone and touch‑screen MacBook to a smart‑home hub, AI glasses and a desktop robot, Apple’s product roadmap for the coming years will move beyond incremental updates to fully new form factors and markets.

Bloomberg reported on Friday the 4th that Apple will hold its “Surprise and Shine” autumn event on September 9 Pacific Time (September 10 Taiwan time), with Ternus—who officially took over as CEO on September 1—hosting for the first time. In addition to a new generation of iPhone and Apple Watch, the event will kick off a wave of major new products slated for 2026‑2029 and beyond.
Apple’s spokesperson declined to comment. Because some products are still in development or testing, launch dates and specifications could change, and some plans may be delayed or cancelled.

The Ternus era opens with Apple abandoning the incremental‑upgrade playbook. Over the past 15 years Apple mainly grew recurring revenue by refining existing products and expanding services. Although categories such as Apple Watch and AirPods were introduced, truly brand‑new device concepts have been scarce.

That is about to change. Over the past five years Apple has been preparing a new product roadmap that includes foldable devices, a touch‑screen Mac, smart‑home gear and AI wearables. Ternus recently told staff that a “spectacular” large‑scale launch is coming next week, and he also hinted at products already in development—or even not yet imagined.

Most of these projects were initiated under former CEO Tim Cook, but the hardware engineering team now led by Ternus is handling development. Cook’s decision to let Ternus present the new lineup underscores Apple’s entry into a new phase; the CEO hand‑over occurring just days before the event adds symbolic weight.

The centerpiece of this year’s cycle will be Apple’s first foldable phone, internally dubbed the “iPhone Ultra.” When opened it will feature a large internal display and a small external screen; folded it will be about the size of a passport and is expected to cost over $2,000.

The phone is expected to run an A20 Pro processor and Apple‑designed C2 modem, support split‑screen multitasking and Touch ID, and use a new hinge that dramatically reduces fold lines. The camera system will include a standard wide‑angle and an ultra‑wide lens, but no telephoto lens.

iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max will largely retain the look of their predecessors, though new light‑blue and deep‑red color options may appear. Internally they will also upgrade to the A20 Pro and C2 modem, with improved battery life and a more efficient heat‑spreader. The Pro Max could add a mechanical aperture for finer control of light and depth of field.

Apple Watch Series 12 will add new colors and a ceramic case, while the Ultra 4 will introduce fresh health and fitness features. Apple is testing an all‑day, continuous heart‑rate sensor that works regardless of activity, and the new models will support an AI‑powered Siri engine.

AirPods 5 will be offered in standard and noise‑cancelling versions, but the AI‑camera‑enabled AirPods have been pushed back to 2027. Apple TV and HomePod mini will keep their designs but will debut faster processors that finally enable Siri AI capabilities.

The iPad mini will receive one of its biggest upgrades ever with an OLED screen for the first time. Apple also plans to launch an iMac powered by an M6 chip and a 14‑inch MacBook Pro, the former marking the first iMac refresh in two years.

More importantly, Apple will debut its first touch‑screen OLED MacBook Pro, the most significant redesign of the line in five years. The new models will come in 14‑inch and 16‑inch sizes, add multi‑touch, a Dynamic Island UI and software optimized for touch, and will be powered by M5 Pro and M5 Max chips.

In 2027 Apple will roll out its first smart‑home hub with a screen—a roughly 7‑inch square display that can sit on a desk or mount on a wall, supporting FaceTime, home‑automation controls, a clock and widgets. Siri AI and facial recognition will personalize content based on the user, representing Apple’s largest smart‑home push to date.

The 2027 lineup will also include a MacBook Air, entry‑level iPad and iPad Pro focused on chip and thermal upgrades, while the iPad Air switches to an OLED panel. Apple plans updates to the Pencil Pro and a new entry‑level USB‑C Apple Pencil.

iPhone release cadence will be split for the first time: the high‑end Pro line stays on the traditional autumn schedule, while the standard iPhone 18, budget iPhone 18e and iPhone Air 2 move to spring 2027. The second‑generation iPhone Air will add an ultra‑wide camera and improve processor and battery life.

Apple is also preparing AirPods with built‑in camera sensors that can use visual cues to provide alerts, analyze surroundings and deliver context‑aware navigation, though they won’t capture photos or video. The company is developing privacy‑first home‑security sensors that monitor the environment with AI rather than recording video.

The most eye‑catching reveal is Apple’s first smart glasses. The initial version will lack a display but will play music, take calls and capture video; its camera will perform the same AI‑vision tasks as the new AirPods, directly challenging Meta’s (META‑US) smart‑glass effort.

2027 marks the 20th anniversary of the iPhone, and Apple plans a major redesign of its flagship model with a fully curved glass front and thinner bezels—the biggest design shift since the iPhone X. A second‑generation foldable iPhone is already in testing, showing Apple’s long‑term confidence in the category.

Looking further ahead, Apple is betting on robots and AR glasses. After 2028 the smart‑home hub is expected to evolve into a desktop robot with a ~9‑inch screen and a movable arm that can face the user, conduct FaceTime calls and deliver richer interactive AI experiences.

Apple is also testing an AI‑enabled pendant that can be clipped to clothing or worn as a necklace, pairing with an iPhone to act as the AI’s “eyes.” This could serve users who don’t want smart glasses or camera‑equipped AirPods, though mass production has not been confirmed.

The future of Vision Pro remains uncertain; Ternus is reported to have reservations about the current design, but a lighter revised version is tentatively slated for late‑2028 or early‑2029. A third‑generation foldable iPhone may feature larger internal and external displays, extending Apple’s foldable strategy.

Apple once prototyped a nearly 20‑inch foldable iPad that was envisioned as a laptop alternative, but pricing, manufacturing and practicality concerns shelved the project—for now, it could be revived later.

The Mac lineup is expected to accelerate OLED adoption from 2028‑2029, including a high‑end MacBook Air and an OLED iMac. Apple’s ultimate goal remains a true augmented‑reality (AR) glasses that overlay information onto the real world via lightweight lenses, though such a product likely won’t appear until the end of the century.

From foldable iPhones to AI glasses and desktop robots, Apple is trying to shed its recent “incremental upgrade” image. Whether these products arrive on schedule is still uncertain, but they will constitute the biggest test of Ternus’s tenure and could shape Apple’s growth trajectory for the next decade.

items.title: 川普救不了美債？殖利率要降恐得先讓經濟變差
items.title_en: Can Trump Rescue U.S. Debt? Yield Drops May Require a Weaker Economy
paras: 美國總統川普一再要求聯準會(Fed)降息，財政部也準備擴大長期公債回購，試圖壓低借貸成本；然而，川普政府自身的政策，可能正是美債殖利率居高不下的原因之一。分析指出，若政策方向不變，美國恐怕必須以經濟轉弱為代價，才可能讓利率與借貸成本真正下降。
過去6個月，美國10年期公債殖利率累計上升約75個基點，近期徘徊在4.8%附近，創川普第二任期以來最高。殖利率走高也推升民眾借貸負擔，30年期房貸利率已逼近6.8%，汽車貸款與其他消費信貸成本同樣受到影響。

海外買家要求更高報酬 美國債務吸引力下滑

美債投資人結構近年逐漸改變，央行與外匯存底管理機構的需求相對下降，對價格更敏感的民間投資人占比提高。川普政府的政策變化也增加海外投資人的避險成本，使部分資金開始降低美債配置。
歐洲保險與資產管理巨擘安聯(Allianz)投資長兼首席經濟學家Ludovic Subran表示，投資人自然會要求美國支付更高的借款價格，這不是政治判斷，而是「純粹的經濟考量」。
他指出，聯邦預算與貿易逆差急升、Fed似乎未積極處理通膨，以及財政部干預市場等因素，都讓美債開始帶有某種類似信用風險的色彩。他並非認為美國必然違約，但包括安聯在內的全球投資人，為美國資產部位避險的成本已明顯增加。
扣除通膨與避險成本後，投資美國長天期債券已難以獲利，因此安聯今年決定不再像過去一樣尋求增加美債存續期間。美國預計將在2027年冬末至年中觸及41.1兆美元債務上限，也使投資人更加重視財政風險。
美國財政部將自下周起提高部分長期公債回購規模，希望改善市場流動性，但投資人仍在評估新任Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)將如何處理高於2%目標的通膨，殖利率因而難以明顯回落。

財政赤字碰上AI發債潮 長債市場爭奪資金

推升殖利率的政治與財政因素暫時沒有消退跡象。油價下跌或許能提供部分緩解，但伊朗戰爭仍未看到結束曙光，華府也缺乏透過政治妥協削減赤字的意願。
美國國會預算辦公室(CBO)近期將本會計年度財政赤字預估上修至2.1兆美元，可能超過國內生產毛額(GDP)的6%。在並非金融危機或經濟衰退的時期，如此龐大的借款需求相當罕見。
部分大型投資人也考慮降低美債部位。挪威主權財富基金正評估將政府債券投資組合中的約800億美元，轉移至房貸抵押證券等殖利率較高的債券資產。
與此同時，AI基礎建設熱潮正在創造另一股龐大的企業融資需求。摩根大通(JPM-US)估計，五大科技公司、輝達(NVDA-US)，以及為資料中心租約提供支持的特殊目的機構，今年迄今已發行約3,200億美元債券。
摩根大通資產管理市場與投資策略部主席Michael Cembalest表示，大型雲端服務商發債規模過於龐大，可能已在殖利率曲線長端引發供需失衡。換言之，美國政府與AI企業正在同一個債券市場爭奪資金，迫使雙方提供更高報酬才能吸引買家。
不過，AI發債潮不一定全是壞事。美國第二季GDP季增年率僅1.5%，低於市場預期，川普政府收緊移民政策導致人口流入放緩，可能也是拖累成長的原因之一。在其他成長動能有限之際，AI投資仍是美國經濟的一大亮點，也可能帶動創新及生產力提升。

殖利率走高未必因通膨 經濟降溫才可能帶來轉機

市場數據顯示，美債殖利率上升並非完全由通膨預期推動。經通膨調整後的10年期抗通膨債券(TIPS)實質殖利率，過去6個月上升67個基點，周四升至2.43%；衡量市場通膨預期的損益兩平通膨率同期卻大致持平。
紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)表示，實質殖利率上升更多反映美國經濟本身的強度。外界常把殖利率攀升解讀為金融環境正在拖累經濟，但因果關係可能恰好相反，是經濟表現影響金融環境，而非金融環境單方面壓抑經濟。
美國8月非農就業人數增加16.2萬人，也顯示勞動市場仍具韌性，儘管企業長期呈現不願大舉招聘、也不急於裁員的局面。若經濟成長與就業持續穩健，Fed便缺乏迅速降低利率的理由，長期公債殖利率也可能維持高檔。
這也形成川普政府難以化解的矛盾：白宮希望壓低殖利率與民間借貸成本，但財政赤字、貿易政策、通膨疑慮與發債供給，卻共同要求投資人索取更高報酬。若川普不願調整政策，真正能讓殖利率明顯下降的因素，可能只剩經濟大幅放緩，但這同時將犧牲成長與就業，顯然不是任何政府樂見的解方。
paras_en: U.S. President Trump repeatedly urges the Federal Reserve to cut rates, and the Treasury is preparing to expand long‑term bond buybacks in an effort to lower borrowing costs; however, the Trump administration’s own policies may be one of the reasons Treasury yields remain high.
